tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ 'dir rje sna tshogs rang grol gyi bka' 'bum chos tshan gyi rnam grangs ji ltar bzhugs pa'i rim pa bkod par glegs bam/ ka)pa la// rnam thar drang po'i sa bon ldeb/ 100 rmi lam nying 'khrul ldeb 17 ched du brjod pa glu'i phreng ba khog dbub dang bcas pa ut+pa la yi do shal ldeb 39 rtse le gong 'og grwa tshang dgon gsum po rnams kyi bstan pa ji ltar btsugs pa'i lo rgyus ldeb/ 36 rje btsun dam pa rdzogs chen pa bsod nams dbang po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus ldeb/ 11 rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po'i sku tshe mjug gi rnam thar mdor bsdus ngo mtshar snang byed ldeb 15 srog chags bstan bcos ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i rol rtsed yid 'ong pad+ma dkar po ldeb 20 rta'i rgyal po bā la ha'i rtogs brjod legs bshad chos kyi rnga sgra ldeb/ mchog dman gyi skyes bu rnams la zhu yig phul ba'i tshogs lhag bsam ngo mtshar sprin gyi skyed tshal ldeb/ 58 bcas bzhugs// 1)

snyigs dus kyi bla ma'i gzugs brnyan 'dzin 'as rang gi mtshan nyid ji lta bar brjod pa drang po'i sa bon ces byas ba bzhugs so/ 2)na mo gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa bh+ya// chos dbyings mkha' la thugs rje'i 'od stong phyogs med 'phro// mtha' yas 'gro ba ngan gro'i g.yang sar 'khyams pa rnams// thugs rje'i rol gar mdzad phrin dpag yas 'od zer gyis// snang bas khyab mdzad kun bzang rdor 'chang spyi bos mchod// bskal mang grangs med sngon nas sems bskyed cing*// khams gsum 'khor ba'i 'gro ba bsgral slad du// dka' ba'i spyod pa dpag med lhur blangs nas// 'gro la phan bde stsol mdzad thugs rje can// rgyal dang rgyal sras 3)byang sams 'phags tshogs la// mi phyed dad pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo// bsod nams chu gter dbus nas legs 'ongs shing*// zab rgyas bdud rtsi'i 'phreng bas rab mdzes klubs// smin grol legs bshad gdengs ka mngon mtho ba'i// rtsa rgyud bla ma'i tshogs la snying nas 'dud// 'gro ba'i khams kun bde gshegs snying pos khyab// rab 'byams zhing kun rgyal ba'i phrin las nyid// snang grags ye nas chos nyid rnam rol 'phrul// thams cad rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal// snyigs dus skye bo rmongs pa bdag lta bu// thos bsam sgom pa'i 4)nor gyi rab dben zhing*// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i nus pa lta zhog gi /skye bo phal pa'i rnar snyan tshig tsam yang*// brjod par nus pa'i rnam dpyod med mod cing*// thog med dus nas bag chags ngan goms shugs// 'khrul pa'i rgya mtsho rnam rtog rba rlabs dang*// nyon mongs dbu ba'i phung po 'khrigs pa las// byung ba'i cal col gtam rnams yi ge ru// bris kyang don gyi snying po cang mchis sam// da dus 'gro ba phal cher nyon mongs rag /sangs rgyas byang sems grub mchog skyes bu dang*// chos rgyal byang sems mdzad spyod rnam thar la'ang*// gus pas 'chad nyan blta rtog mi byed par// chos dang gang zag ya bral dus 'di 'drar// bdag 'dras smras kyang ngal ba don med las// phan pa'i don du ji ltar 'gyur zhig gu// 'on kyang bskul ba po yi bzhed skong phyir// rang gi tshul rnams drang por brjod pa 'di// mkhas pa'i spyan sngar

5)brim pa med na'ang*// cung zad smras la bzod par mdzad du gsol/ de yang longs spyod rdzogs sku rnam par snang mdzad gangs chen mtsho'i phyag gi lhung bzed kyi nang*/ spos chu'i rgya mtsho las mngon par byung ba'i pad+ma nyi shu rtsa lnga brtsegs pa'i khyon kun zhing khams kyis brgyan pa las/ mchog tu gyur pa gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i gnas/ bcu gsum pa mi mjed kyi zhing 'di nyid las/ dbus kyi ri bo mchog rab kyi lho/ 'dzam gling sog kha shing rta'i dbyibs can gyi dbus ma gha dha rdo rje gdan zhes bya ba shākya'i dbang po mngon par byang chub pa'i bsti gnas dam pa de nyid las/ dpag tshad brgya lhag byang phyogs su bgrod pa'i yul/ gangs ri'i phreng bas mngon par dkrigs pa'i yul ljongs bod ces bya ba 'di nyid du 'od gsal gyi lha las babs pa'i rgyal rgyud rim bzhin byon pa'i nang nas/ thugs rje'i 6)bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs dbang mi'i gzugs su bzhengs nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po phrin las kyi rol pa mngon par bstan pa'i dus na/ chos blon chen po thon mi sam bho ṭa zhes bya ba/ lugs gnyis kyi mkhyen rab zla med du mchis pas/ rgyal pos rgya gar du brdzangs shing mkhas pa li byin la sogs pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang zhig gis rjes su bzung nas/ sgra dang yi ge'i rig gnas mtha' dag la mkhas pa'i phul du phyin par gyur te/ slar log nas bod du yi ge'i bstan pa dar bar byas zhing*/ dkon mchog sprin dang pad+ma dkar po la sogs pa'i dam chos mang du bsgyur/ shes rab kyi stobs rtsal mtha' yas pa'i sgo nas 'gro ba rnams la phan pa rgya cher mdzad cing*/ rgyal po nyid kyi phrin las par gyur pa ste/ bdag de'i tshe de'i dus na/ chos blon de nyid du gyur to zhes/ rig 'dzin gyi gter ston chen po 'ja' 7)tshon snying pos bka' bstsal zhing*/ gzhan yang*/

bcom ldan 'das kyi nye gnas kun dga' bor gyur nas bka'i sdu ba po byas shing bstan pa'i srog shing dam par gyur pa dang*/ bod kyi bstan pa snga dar gyi tshe/ lo tsā ba chen po bai ro tsa nar gyur nas spyir sde snod rgyud sde mang po dang khyad par man ngag rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan pa spel ba'i tshul dang*/ gzhan yang 7rje btsun sa skya paṇa chen grub chen khyung po rnal 'byor/ gter ston rdo rje gling pa/ sprul sku mchog ldan mgon po/ gter ston kun skyong gling pa la sogs pa mkhas grub skyes chen dam pa mang po zhig gi skye ba dang sprul pa khyod yin pas/ sems can gyi don la blo rgya bskyed par gyis shig ces/ bdag la bka' yi nan thug yang yang mdzad cing mchis na'ang*/ bdag lta bu ni thog ma med pa nas bsags sbyang gi nus pa dman pa'i dbang gis/ da 8)lta'i bar du 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor zo chu'i 'khyud mo lta bu'i klong na rgyun du 'khyam zhing*/ thos bsam sgom sogs kyi sbyangs yon dang spangs rtogs kyi 'bras bu ni sgo du ma nas rab tu dman pa las kyang*/ nyon mongs kyi 'ching ba dam pos rtag tu bcings te 'khrul pa lu gu rgyud kyi rjes su 'brangs shing nyin mtshan kun tu le lo rnam g.yeng gis dus 'da' ba 'di lta bu ni skyes chen dam pa de dag gi skye bar ci zhig rung mod kyi/ 'di ni nges par bdag la dge sbyor la bskul zhing spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir gsungs par gor ma chags snyam mo/ ring nas goms shing sbyangs pas legs bshad kyis// skal ldan thar gling 'khrid mkhas ded dpon mchog skyes mchog mi yi seṅge de rnams ni// gangs can mun sel sgron mer legs gyur mod// rgyal sras dam pa'i rmad byung mdzad phrin ni// se gol yun la'ang stong gsum bye phrag brgyar/ 9)/rnam grol du mas 'gro ba sgrol nus pa'i// mkhyen brtse'i gting mtha' dpog par su yis nus// ma rig mun par 'khyams pa bdag 'dra'i rigs// gzhan don lta zhog rang gi mdun ma yang*// las rlung shugs kyis gar bskyod ma gtogs pa// 'di ltar bya zhes rang dbang ma thob pa'i// nyams chung 'di 'dra'i tshe rabs gong ma ni// blun rmongs byol song las gzhan 'os ci zhig

'on kyang rgyal ba rnams kyi mdzad pa la// mi srid pa ni gang yang med pa ste// shākya'i dbang po byang chub spyod pa'i tshe// nya sogs dud 'gro'i tshul du'ang snang bar 'gyur// ji ltar nags na gnas pa'i bya tshogs dag rang 'dra'i rigs mthun rnams la dga' byed cing*// shes ldan mi la log ltas 'bros byed bzhin// ma rig mun pas ldongs pa'i skye bo rnams// sku dngos kyis ni 'dul ba'i skal med tshe// rigs mthun 10)gzugs sprul yin par rlom na rung*// gdod ma'i mgon po chos sku man chad nas// 'jag mig gnas pa'i srin 'bu yon chad kun// bde gshegs snying por ye nas gcig pa yin// mdo rgyud lung la rten par rung ngam ci/ yang*/ bdag gi skye ba 'di yi gong ma ni mtshungs med bstan 'dzin rdo rje de nyid yin par grags pa ste/ de yang slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sprul pa/ pha sgom pa sangs rgyas zhes bya ba de nyid sham po'i gangs la sgrub pa mdzad cing bzhugs pa'i tshe/ gu ru pad+ma nyid khye'u lo brgyad pa'i gzugs su sprul bas lung bstan pa la brten nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la 'phur nas byon ste/ mchims yul nga la zhes bya ba'i ri rtser babs nas bzhugs shing*/ nga la brag btsan dam la btags te ri steng gi dgon pa 'debs par mdzad/ de nyid kyi mthun rkyen la dgongs pa'i zhing mo che zhes bya ba zhig yod pas 11)nga la brag btsan la/ zhing 'di ni nam 'debs pa'i char pa re yong ba gyis gsungs pa la brten/ da lta yang zhing de ni nam 'debs kyang kha char nges par 'bab pa'i ya mtshan kyang yod cing*/ sgom pa sangs rgyas de gnyis kyi gdung rabs yan chad kyi rim par byon pa thams cad kyang 'gro don rlabs chen nus pa sha stag byon zhing*/ sgom pa sangs rgyas kyi sras ni pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyi slob ma blo gros rgyal mtshan/ de'i sras chos rje byang chub rin chen/

de sras mtshungs med rin chen rgya mtsho/ de'i sras gsum yod pa las bla ma dbang phyug rgya mtsho'i sras su mtshungs med bstan 'dzin rdo rje 'di nyid 'khrungs/ dbang phyug rgya mtsho'i sras che ba ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po/ de'i sras bla ma ngag dbang grags pa/ de'i sras bla ma tshe brtan sogs 'di dag yin no/ mchan/ gdung rabs drug pa'i thog tu byon pa'i dam pa 'di nyid/ sku gzhon nu'i tshe chu sprul du 'khrungs nas dgung lo bcu gnyis la/ sa lugs kyi grwa sa gcig tu byon nas/ dbu mdzad 12) sogs rgyu mtshan nyid kyi thog pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhas par mdzad/ slar sngon gyi smon lam gyis rgyud bskul bas/ dwags po rtse le gsang sngags kyi pho brang du rig 'dzin chen po bsod nams rnam par rgyal ba dang*/ de sras dpal o rgyan bstan 'dzin zhes bya ba/ g.yu sgra snying po'i skye ba 'gran zla med pa'i mkhas grub chen po de nyid kyi drung du dgung lo bcu bdun la/ mchan/ byon nas/ nor bzang dang rtag tu ngu lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bskur bsti'i bya ba la nyin mtshan dus rnams kun tu ngal ba med par mdzad cing bla ma mnyes par byas te/ bka' mdo rgyud lung man ngag dpag tu med pa dang*/ khyad par gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi gdams pa bka' gter mtha' dag la sgro 'dogs chod par 'gyur/ dpal o rgyan bstan 'dzin de nyid la bu slob dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po grangs las 'das pa yod na'ang*/ dam pa 'di nyid kho na la dgongs rtsi gtod par mdzad cing*/ khyad 13)par gsang sngags rnying ma la dge 'dun gyi sde tshogs dkon par 'dug pas/ khyed rnams kyi mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi sgo nas snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa la phan pa zhig gyis ces bka' stsal zhing*/ smin grol skyed rdzogs gling gi chos sde gtsugs nas de'i dbu mdzad du bkos/ slar yongs 'dzin dam pa o rgyan bstan 'dzin de nyid zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i rjes su grwa tshang nyid du gang yod rnams kyis

{ dgung lo nyer brgyad/ mchan/ }kong phyogs su phyin te dpal rnam thos kyi ri bor rje thams cad mkhyen pa gtsug lag 'phreng ba'i sgar 'dabs su yod skabs/ grwa tshang gi bla ma mkhyen rab rnam rgyal zhes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' zhig yod pa sku ma 'tsho ba'i tshe/ rje gtsug lag phreng bas/ dam pa 'di nyid grwa tshang gi bla mar bkod bar mdzad cing*/ lta ba yul gyi rgya bdag sogs yon bdag tu sbyor ba gnang nas// lugs gnyis ka nas bka' drin zla med du bskyangs bar 'gyur 14)slar rim gyis dpon bsam 'phel don 'grub sogs kyis thang 'brog gi dgon gzhis phul ba la brten nas/ so gcig pa la/ mchan/ bla brang dang shag sgor sogs bzos shing grwa tshang gi rten gzhi legs par grub/ dpal o rgyan bstan 'dzin gyi sku skye ba phyi ma gdan drangs nas grwa tshang gtsug rgyan du mnga' gsol bas phrin las kyi sgo nyi ma shar ba lta bus snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa'i sgron me gcig pu par gyur/ de dag gi skabs su kong btsun de mo mnal lam du yang yang byung nas phrin las bsgrub par khas blangs ba mang du byung rung*/ rmi lam 'khrul pa'i 'char sgo la snying po med par dgongs pas ji mi snyam pa'i ngang du bzhugs kyang gdong grogs byed pa'i rtags mtshan ni rgyun du byung*/ long zhe bdun la/ mchan/ po bde chen dgon du'ang dge 'dun gyi sde dang*/ gnas lnga la/ mchan/ chen chu bo g.yas 'khyil du snying po'i don la spyod pa'i sgrub grwa yang rgya cher 'jug par mdzad/ de dag gi skabs 'ga' zhig tu 15)bdud rigs kyi skye bo ma rungs pa dag gis snga 'gyur snying po'i bstan pa la phrag dog gis kun nas blangs pas mi 'tshams pa'i spyod pa du ma'i sgo nas bar chad brtsams kyang*/ byams snying rjes kun nas blangs te rang sar zhi bar mdzad/ 'ga' zhig la ni drag po mngon spyod kyi phrin las chos skyong gnad nas bskul zhing bran tu bkol bas/

log par 'dren pa rnams tshar gcod rjes 'dzin gyi brtul zhugs kyis kyang 'dul bar mdzad pa ste/ mdor na rje brtsun mi tra dzo gis rdo rje gdan du gar log gi dmag dpung bzlog pa'i mdzad pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i sgo nas 'brel tshad don ldan du mdzad/ snod ldan gyi gdul bya rnams la/ smin byed kyi sgrub dbang dang grol byed kyi zab khrid la sogs pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo ni rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lor stsal zhing*/ de dag gi skabs rnams su gu ru 16)mtshan brgyad la sogs pa'i yi dam gyi lha tshogs zhal gzigs pa dang*/ mnal lam dag snang la rnga yab gling du byon nas zangs mdog dpal ri'i pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang la bskor ba mdzad pa sogs dag pa'i gzigs pa ni mtha' yas/ dus dang rnam pa kun tu sku la chos gos rnam gsum 'bral med/ gsung yi dam gyi bzlas brjod/ thugs stong nyid snying rje sogs mdo sngags zung 'jug gi nyams bzhes dang mdzad bzang gi spyan ltos ni gzhan las khyad par 'phags shing sku 'khor du 'khod pa thams cad kyang sdom gsum rnam par dag cing sbyangs yon phun sum tshogs pa'i dge sbyong sha stag tu 'gyur ba'i thugs rje dang ldan pa ste skyes bu dam pa'i mtshan nyid mtha' dag dang ldan/ sku tshe'i smad du phal cher sgrub pa la bzhugs shing*/ zhal nas kyang kho bo'i bsam pa thams cad chos mthun du 'grub cing*/ da ni tshe yi tshad kyang mthar phyin pas/ lo chen rin chen bzang po'i sku tshe'i smad kyi mdzad pa la yid smon du 17)bgyis pa yin zhes kyang gsungs zhing*/ dgongs bzhed mtha' dag 'grub cing dgung lo don gsum gyi bar du mdzad pa mthar phyin te/ sku mya ngan las 'da' khar dad ldan 'ga' zhig la/ nga'i skye ba phyi ma ni yul phyogs tha 'khob bkres shig tu skye bar 'dug go zhes yang yang gsungs pa la brten/ sku'i skye ba bdag yin par grags pa las/

dam pa de dag gi yon tan dang mdzad pa ni skra rtse'i khyon tsam yang bdag 'dras rjes su snyegs pa ma mchis so// dam pa de nyid la o rgyan rin po ches lung bstan pa yang*/ thar pa gling gi gnas yig las// bai ro tsa na'i sprul pa snying stobs can// rdzogs chen a ti rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// nyan thos tshul gyi mthu stobs can// sbrang tshang lta bu'i dgon grwa 'debs// yi dam snying po rgya rtsa bzlas// rta mgrin gsung yang thos pa 'byung*/ zhes gsungs pa dang rjes su mthun par/ grwa 18)tshang dang sgrub sde sogs dar rgyas su mdzad cing*/ bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub pa chen mo mdzad pa'i skabs su/ dpal rta mgrin gyi rta mgos rta skad rab tu 'tsher ba gsan tshe/ nyid kyi thugs dgongs la/ rta skad 'dis 'dzam gling sum gnyis tsam du thos yod las che snyam pa byung gsungs par snang ngo*/ e ma/ rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rje'i dam bca' ni// ri rab rdul du sil la'ang ngal bral zhing*// dmyal mer lan brgyar zhugs la'ang mi 'jigs par// 'gro ba sgrol la brtson mdzad la ltos na// 'khor ba da dung ma stong ci zhig gu /dam pa 'di lta'i rnam par thar pa ni// bsags sbyangs 'bad pas 'bras bu legs smin kyang*// rgya mtsho chu yi ngoms pa med pa bzhin// blang dor gnas la rtse gcig mdzad pa des// bkod pa du mas brgyan pa'i zhing dag tu// 'pho dang lhums zhugs bltams shing rol rtsed dang*// mngon byung byang chub snying por bdud sde gzhom/ 19) /sangs rgyas chos 'khor bskor ba las gzhan pa'i// nyon mongs mngal sgo 'grim zhing ci phyir bzhugs// 'on te 'gro phan slad du skye bzhes kyang*// 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i rnam rol can dag las// rang gzhan don gnyis spyod la rmongs pa yi// nyam chung bdag 'drar 'gyur ba cang srid dam// snyigs ma'i yang snying rtsod ldan mthar thug cing*// bstan pa'i nyi ma nub rir gzhol dus 'dir// thabs mkhas thugs rje ldan pa'i skyes bu'i mchog

byams pa'i go bgos snying rje'i mtshon 'thogs shing*// brtson 'grus rta zhon smon 'jug ru dar 'phyar// thos bsam sgom pa'i dpung tshogs mthu ldan gyis// 'khor ba'i g.yul ngo bzlog byed ma gtogs pa'i// bla ma'i go sa 'dzin rnams snying rje'i gnas// ltar snang mdzes pa'i 'dun ma bsgrub bsgrub nas// yang dag don gyi 'dun ma stor nyen 20)gda'// bdag kyang chos kyi skal ba dman pa'i mthus// sku skyer ming du thogs pa 'di yis bslus// bslab sbyangs yon tan nor rdzas 'tshol phyir tsam// bya ba'i las kun blun po mgu byed nyid// bshad pa'i chos kyang ge sar sgrungs gtam 'dra// 'di 'dra'i bla mas rang gzhan smin 'gyur ram// nges 'byung bsam pa 'du 'dzi'i grog gis bcings// dge blo'i mar me rnam g.yeng rlung gis bskyod// zab mo'i gdams pa yig thog dpe la lus// byed lo'i chos kyi mi tshe bud de mchis// da nas tshe rabs gar skye kun tu yang*// rnyed 'tshol skye bo mgu byed sku skyes dang*// kun phung tshul chos spyod pa'i bla ma dang*// rang 'dod chos brgyad mkhan gyi bshes gnyen sogs// bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren rnams su ma gyur cig mi med lung stong rgyal bas bsngags pa'i gnas// 'du 'dzi chags sdang bral ba'i bsti gnas su// tshe 'di blos 21)thongs sgrub pa mthar phyin nas// rang gzhan don gnyis yang dag 'grub par shog tshe rabs snga ma'i tshul las 'phros pa'i le'u ste dang po'o/

da ni skye ba 'di yi byed spyod kyi tshul brjod pa la/ ya mtshan zhing ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar ni bdag la ma mchis/ tha mal gyi spyod pa ci byed thams cad yi ger bris na ni/ sa gzhi la shog gu byas shing phyi'i rgya mtsho la snag tsha byas te bris kyang mi langs shing ngal ba'i rgyur zad mdo kyang*/ bskul ba po yi ngo mi bzlog phyir rang tshul cung zad brjod par bya ste/ de yang bdag skye ba'i yul ni/ gu ru'i sbas yul dwags po lung pa'i mjug kong yul shing lo'i tshal gyi 'go mkha' spyod dpal gyi rtswa ri'i byang phyogs/ chu bo gser ldan rba klong 'khrug pa'i 'gram/ slob dpon pad+mas byin gyis brlabs shing*/ bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i rtsa 22)ba'i rgyud drug gter du sbas pa'i sar yin te/ de yang dgongs 'dus kyi lo rgyus shel 'phreng las/ 'di dag ni rgya rim pa bdun gyis btab nas/ sbas pa'i yul chung ngam dang dul zhes bya ba'i lung par/ shar phyogs su ri kha ṭ+wā+oṃ gdengs pa lta bu/ lho phyogs ni srin po khros pa 'dra ba/ nub phyogs ni sog po khros pa 'dra ba/ byang phyogs su chu dar dkar 'phyar ba 'dra ba'i lung par/ nel ma'i ljongs ha cang mi che ba'i dkyil du/ brag gu rta thod bzhag pa 'dra ba'i sna la sbas zhing rgyas btab ste/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i gter gnas de nyid dang nye ba dul zhes bya ba'i yul du/ o rgyan rin po che'i sgrub gnas kyi mdun du/ rgyal me tog thang nas chad pa'i mi rgyud las byung ba'i pha skyabs pa dang ma rta mgrin bu khrid gnyis kyi bu gcig pur bdag skyes pa lags te/ de yang rig 'dzin chen po 'ja' tshon snying pos gsungs nas 23)bdag gi pha 'di skye ba snga ma lha'i gnas 'phos pa yin zhing*/ ma ni sngon sman mo'i rigs zhig tu skyes pa yin 'dug ces gsung ba thos shing*/ pha ma gnyis ka'ang rang bzhin gyis rgyud drang zhing dge la dga' ba'i rigs can du gyur/

de la bdag thog mar ma'i khong du zhugs dus ma'i rmi lam na/ bla ma bgres po dbu skra dkar po can/ sku la chos gos dmar po gsol ba chibs pa dang bcas pa zhig rang gi khyim du byon pa yang yang rmis pa pha la bshad pas/ de 'dra rgyal po'i cho 'phrul las 'os ci yod zer kyang*/ phyis khyed la blta bar 'dug zer/ yang bdag nyid khong du yod pa'i dus zhig du/ ma'i rmi lam du nam mkha' nas nyi ma gsum dus gcig tu shar ba'i g.yas g.yon gnyis cung zad 'od chung zhing*/ dbus ma de 'od rab tu 'bar ba 'ja' skor rim pa mang 24)pos bskor ba shar ba dang*/ yang lan gcig shing chen po sngar mthong ma myong ba gung la reg pa zhig la dar cog dpag tu med pa gtsugs pa gcig gi rtsa bar bsdad nas// shing sdong 'di las che ba lho dzam bu gling na med byas pa rmis zer ba sogs rmi lam mang po phyis bdag la bshad byung rung gtad pa mi yong bsam nas bdag gi yid la ma bzhag de nas sa pho spre'u'i lo/ dus 'khor lugs kyi ston tha 'bring po'i tshes bcu'i nyi ma rtse shar la bdag btsas par gda' zhing*/ bdag gi gong du byis pa gcig gnyis ma sos pa'i rkyen gyis bdag kyang 'brug lugs kyi grub chen pa shes rab dpal bzang zer ba zhig gi drung du srog bcol gyi rnam pa byas shing ming yang shes rab tu btags/ bshad mi shes pa'i dus nas gar 'dug lta stangs kyi rnam pa byas nas sdod cing*/ zas za ba'i tshe yang cog rtse'i rnam pa shing 25)leb lta bu gcig mdun du ma bzhags pa la zas mi za ba byed 'dug zer/ de nas rim gyis bshad shes 'phral nas gtsang po mgo dgur 'gro dgos yod/ der nga'i rdor dril la sogs chas mang po yod cing*/ rta dmar po gdong la mar gyis byugs pa lta bu gcig kyang yod zer ba/ chibs nor bu rlung gshog la zer ba yin par 'dug ces phyis grwa pa rnams kyis gleng ba mthong*/ chung ngu'i dus nas zas sngo ngad dang dkar gyi rigs ma gtogs pa sha dmar po sogs mthong na skyug bro zhes zer zhing 'bros par byed/

skabs su nyin gung tsam gyi tshe pha ma yod sar lag gnyis gdong la dal bus 'phur zhing snyug bud pa'i tshul gyis/ e ma/ gtsang po mgo dgur yin na nyi ma da tshod tsam la ja 'thung rgyu yod pa yin te 'dir mi 'dug ces zer te/ pha mas ni gtsang po mgo 26)dgu zhes pa gar yod kyang ma shes shing cha ma 'tshal/ nyin par thams cad du mi med pa'i sar phyin nas lus lta stangs dang lag pa mnyam bzhag byas nas sdod pa la brten nas/ mi kun gyi 'di sgom chen pa bzang po gcig gi skye ba yin pa 'dra zhes gleng*/ pha ma sogs zhing las la 'gro dus lhan cig 'khrid tshe/ nga zhing la mi 'gro/ 'bu mang po gsad yong zer nas 'gol ba'i sar gcig pu+ur 'dug par byed/ skabs su brag gi steng du 'dug nas byis pa zla bo rnams la chos bshad pa'i tshul dang dbang bskur ba'i rnam 'gyur kho na byed cing*/ rogs gzhan med tsa na rdo mang po sgrigs nas dbang bskur ba'i tshul byed/ rtag tu 'khar ba zhig 'thogs shing na so rgan po yin pa'i bag chags sha stag dang*/ dgon pa'i dbyibs dang grwa pa'i mig sogs/ nga la grwa pa dam chos gsum yod de/ dam chos dpal bzang*/ dam chos phun tshogs/ dam chos bshes gnyen dang gsum/ dkon mchog gsum yod de/ dkon mchog rdo rje/ dkon mchog bstan 'dzin/ dkon mchog bstan 'phel dang gsum yin no/ mchan/ brjod pa la pha mas bkag cing tshe la bar chad yong gi dogs pa'i sems 'phral gyis gzhan la gsang*/ ban de mthong tshad la nga bsu mkhan yin las che zer zhing rgyugs/ bdag skyes nas lo lnga lon tshe sring mo gcig skyes pa de nyid lo bzhi lon nas shi ba'i ro la 'ja'i gur khang phub par gyur/ bdag ni dus rtag tu dam pa'i chos kho na la 'gro rengs shing*/ yul mi rnams kyis kyang pha ma la/ byis pa 'dis khyod gnyis kyi bu byed pa mi 'dug kho rang chos la ma btang na tshe'i bar chad yong nyen yod pas btang ba drag

ces zer na'ang pha ma ni/ bu gzhan med pa'i stabs kyis sems la ma rangs/ de nas bdag lo lnga pa'i tshe/ grwa tshang nas kyang mtshungs med de nyid kyi phyag 'phreng la sogs pa'i sku chas khyer nas brtag 28)dpyad byed par slebs tshe/ chas rnams la ngos 'dzin gsal por byung zer te phyis bdag gis ni ma dran/ nyin mtshan med par dgon pa kho na yid la bcags shing*/ khyim tshang la btson ra lta bu'i 'du shes byung rung dbang ni med/ khong rnams kyi 'bod mkhan ni rim pa bzhin slebs kyang pha mas ni ma btang*/ lan gcig khong rnams gros byed par nyan pas chos la mi gtong bar go nas/ bdag bros nas phyin te lung pa'i mda' na zam pa yod sar sleb tshe/ rang gi mes po rgan po rjes su slebs nas bdag pang pas btab nas khyer te yar log par brtsams tshe/ bdag gi bsam par 'o na cis kyang mi gtong na chu 'di la shi na rung snyam ste lus stobs ci yod kyi phra shag byas te zam kha nas lhung bar 'dod kyang shed kyis ma 'khyongs par a mes yar khyer/ khyim du slebs nas nyin mtshan med par ngu zhing zas skom yang mi 'dod par pha 29)ma la khros te bsdad pas/ de nas pha mas kyang da 'di ma btang na lar nas yong ba mi 'dug pas chos la gtong dgos ces gleng ba byung ngo*/ kye ma mi lus rin chen thob dus 'dir// 'khor ba'i 'dam nas thar pa'i dka' las la// chos las log nas khyim thabs byed pa rnams// khong snying rnag tu rul lam gdon gyis brlom// dal 'byor thob pa brgya la re 'ga' tsam// 'khor 'das so mtshams da res byed dus 'dir// gru las 'thon nas chu la slar 'chong ltar// rang phung rang gis bsgrub kun ci zhig bsam// rang dbang yod dus dam chos bsgrub byas nas// 'chi khar 'gyod med grabs gshom mi byed par// mi tshe don med stong zad btang btang ste// nam zhig 'gyod kyang mi phan gros nyes so// tshe 'di ring kyang lo brgyar bsdod mkhan dkon// de yi bar du tshe phyed gnyid

30)kyis 'das// de lhag rnams kyang phal cher rnam g.yeng ngang*// don du 'gyur nges ci zhig 'dug gam bsoms/ de nas bdag rang lo drug pa'i thog tu/ dwags po skye zhes bya bar smin grol skyed rdzogs gling nas dpon slob rnams yig drug dung phyur 'dren par byon pa'i drung du phyin te/ paṇa chen dā na shi la nyid 'gro ba'i don du bsam bzhin srid pa bzhes pa'i chos kyi rje mchog grub rnam par rgyal ba'i drung la skra gcod par zhus tshe/ khyod kyi skra gcod pa'i bla ma ngas mi yong bas/ rgyal ba yab sras gcig gi drung skra phud 'bul du 'jug pa yin gsungs shing*/ rim gyis kong po'i phyogs su phyin nas gtsang po mgo dgur thog mar sleb dus/ khong rnams kyi rol mo la sogs pa'i bsu ba dang bcas pa'i dgon pa'i dgon pa mthong ba tsam gyis rmi lam mngon sum yin snyam pa'i dga' spro tshad med pa byung*/ 31)gzim khang du slebs 'phral/ sngon mtshungs med de nyid kyi gsol dkar sngo khra ma zhig yod pa de cung zad chag nas mchod bshams kyi 'og tu kha sbub te bzhag 'dug pa mthong tshe/ khyod tshos nga yi dkar yol bcag 'dug byas nas ngus pas/ khong gzhan rnams ni mig rig rig por 'dug cing*/ slob dpon dam chos dpal bzang ni mchi ma 'byin zhing gda' ba da lta yang dran/ slar rim pas thang 'brog gzhis kha sogs su slebs nas yod skabs/ skyabs gnas dam pa dpal gtsug lag rgya mtsho dga' ba'i dbyangs kyi zhal snga nas kong phyogs su 'gro don la byon nas/ thang 'brog tu phebs tshe skra phud phul zhing*/ karma rig 'dzin rnam par rgyal ba zhes pa'i ming gnang nas/ skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen gyi bslab pa legs par stsal/ grub rgyal ma nas brgyud 32)pa'i tshe dbang dang*/ sgrol dkar yin bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes gnang dang*/ rje btsun me tri'i snying po don gsum la sogs pa'i zab chos mang du gnang*/

de'i skabs shig gi rmi lam du/ bdag gcig pu sa phyogs gcig nas phar phyin tshe/ mi nag po phag gi mgo can 'jigs su rung ba gcig gi lag na lcags gzer mtho gang tsam pa mang po khyer nas byung ba la/ bdag gi khyed su yin/ lcags gzer de rnams kyi ci byed dris pas/ de na re/ bdag ni gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i las mkhan rak+ṣa phag mgo yin/ lcags gzer 'di rnams ni 'jig rten gyi khams na sha za mkhan gyi lus la btab rgyu yin zer bas/ bdag gi bsam pa la/ 'o na bdag kyang sha zos pa yin pas btab las che/ sems can gyi sha zos pa la nyes dmigs 'di lta bu yod par 'dug da ni bdag thabs gzhan med pas gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas la skyabs zhu 33)ba drag snyam ste mig btsum ste rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab nas yun cig song ba dang mig phyis nas bltas pas/ sngar gyi mi nag po de med par bdag gi mdun gyi nam mkhar me tog pad+ma dmar po'i gdan gyi steng du/ gu ru pad+ma yin bsam pa'i bla ma gzi mdangs dang ldan pa zhal 'dzum bag can/ sku la na bza' thams cad dmar po kho na gsol zhing dbu la paṇa zhu can zhig phyag na shel las grub pa'i nyid kyi sku tshab shig bsnams 'dug pa de dag gi spyi bor bzhag cing smon lam mang po gsungs pa'i 'jug tu sems can gyi don rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig ces gsung grags pa'i 'phro la gnyid sad nas/ lus thams cad rngul zhum me bar 'dug cing sems spro ba'i rnam pa zhag mang po'i bar du byung ngo*/ de nas chos kyi rje mchog grub pas bdag gi slob dpon du dge slong dge 'dun dpal bzang 'jog par gnang ba 34)las/ de nyid kyis bdag la thugs ha cang brtse drag pa'i rnam pas/ bdag gi slob gnyer gyi 'phar sgo zhig ma byung bar/ slar slob dpon rin po che dam chos phun tshogs kyi drung du bsdad cing*/ klog pa nas nye bar bzung ste sku drin shin tu che bar byung*/

rang lo brgyad nas bcu gcig gi bar du rje btsun dam pa bsod nams dbang po'i drung du bsdad/ zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol/ rdo rje sems dpa' snying gi thig le/ gzhan yang snying thig gi skor bzhi/ bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i phyag gcod gnyis/ kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i bstan bcos mdzod bdun gyi skor kha yar dang grub thob tshem bu pa nas brgyud pa'i thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid sogs chos bka' mang po zhig gi dbang lung khrid sogs mtha' de dag sgo nas rjes su bzung ste/ mdor na rang rig chos skur ngo sprod pa'i bla ma ni dam pa 'di nyid kho na yin zhing sku drin dpag tu med do/ gzhan yang chos 35)kyi rje mchog grub rnam rgyal gyi drung du/ rdzogs chen gyi rgyud bcu bdun dang*/ dgongs 'dus kyi don dbang la sogs pa'i dbang rjes gnang mang rab zhig thob/ rang lo bcu gcig pa'i tshe/ spo bo ye gong gi phyogs su phyin nas/ gu ru o rgyan bstan 'dzin pa'i drung du dgongs 'dus kha thor dang*/ thugs rje chen po yang snying 'dus pa la sogs chos bka' 'ga' zhig zhus/ gzhan yang lha lcam pad+ma gsal gyi skye mtha' gter ston rig 'dzin stsal dang mjal tshe/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gus pa thob cing*/ de nyid kyis kyang bdag sku pang du blangs nas mgo la phyag gis byil byil mdzad cing*/ a la la/ sngon gyi gan jag thang lta de da lta 'di lta bu gcig tu gyur zin zhes yang yang gsungs shing rab tu mnyes par mdzad cing*/ khong rang gis gter nas spyan drangs pa'i zab chos bla ma nor bu pad 'phreng gi 36)sgrub skor zhi drag thams cad kyi dbang lung bka' gtad dang bcas pa mdzad cing*/ phar la'ang tshe khrid rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang sogs dgongs bzhed ltar phul/ dus phyis kyang khong rang gis chos bka' de rnams rgyal ba'i dbang po chos dbyings rdo rje la 'bul bar byon nas phyir 'khor ba'i skabs su'ang bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyud lung nyi shu dang*/

rig 'dzin zhig po gling pa'i gter chos mtha' dag dang*/ mnga' bdag myang lugs kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i chos skor la sogs dpag tu med pa sku drin du stsol bar mdzad/ de dag gi skabs lan gcig gi tshe/ gu ru rin po ches byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas phran rgyab mtha' brag zhes pa'i ri khrod gcig tu mtshams la bsdad yod pa'i tshes bcu'i nub rmi lam du/ bdag rang zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang du 'gro ba'i 'dun pas lho nub kyi nam mkha' la 'phur te phyin pas/ spang ljongs shin tu 37)nyams dga' ba me tog gi rigs mi 'dra ba mang po skyes pa zhig tu sleb tshe/ zangs mdog dpal ri yin zer ba'i shel gyi pha bong chen po sbra phub pa tsam zhig la nyi ma'i mdangs phog tshe 'ja' 'od kyi lung pa thams cad khyab pa/ rtsa ba'i phyogs thams cad nas chu mig mang po 'bab pa zhig 'dug pa/ bdag gi bsam pa la/ sngon gu ru chos dbang dang rat+na gling pa sogs kyis rnga yab gling du byon dus kyi bkod pa lo rgyus rnams su yod pa bdag ni phyogs mtshams yang 'dir mi 'dug 'on kyang bdag rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams pa 'di tsam zhig ma gtogs/ pho brang dngos dang gu ru rin po che sogs mjal ba'i skal ba dang mi ldan zhing las sgribs kyis btum yod par 'dug snyam pa'i yid skyo lhang nge ba'i ngang nas/ brag de la skor ba bskor zhing chu mig nas 'thung ba dang khrus byas pa rmis/ de'i sang nub de yang gu ru rin po che 38)la gsol ba btab cing rmi lam bzung nas rnga yab gling du 'gro ba'i 'dun pa byas pa'i rmi lam na/ ri chen po gcig gi sked pa yan chad thams cad na bun thibs nas mi mthong ba'i sked smad tsam du bdag dang grogs 'ga' re 'dug pa gcig tu/ me tog ser po shin tu che ba mang po skyes 'dug pa la/ bdag gi me tog gcig lag tu len grab byas pas/ grogs gcig gis/ gzhog gzhog de khyed rang skye ba phyi ma skye ba yin zer ba'i mod la gnyid sad do/

de yang bdag lo bcu gcig pa'i thog tu chos kyi rje mchog grub rnam par rgyal ba nyid zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i stabs kyis/ bdag la bla ma'i ming 'khral dang grwa tshang gi rnyed 'tshol ba la babs pas/ rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzis rtag tu g.yeng ste thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba kun dang rgyab gyes su gyur/ la lung kun tu 'khyams zhing skye bo mgu byed kyi bya ba sna tshogs 39)bgyis pa'i don 'bras su zang zing gi dngos po 'ga' zhig rnyed pa'i tshe 'khor slob mtha' dag yid mgu zhing kha bsag gis kun nas bstod cing ga zha'i sgra 'byin/ dar cig tsam zhig 'du 'dzi bskyungs nas dben par gnas na khyed kyis bdag cag 'dor bar phod dam zhes nyam thag pa'i rnam 'gyur ston/ 'on te ji tsam rnyed pa'i nor rdzas dag kyang mchod sbyin sogs bgyis nas tshogs gnyis bsog pa'i bya ba la gzhol na ni su gang gis 'dun par mi byed/ rnyed pas rnyed pa 'tshol ba tshong pa g.yo can lta bu'i spyod pa dang*/ lus kyi phyi btsongs nas nang gso ba'i ngang la mi tshe 'bud pa 'di yid la ma rangs kyang*/ klu'i rgyal po e la'i 'dabs kyi spyi bo'i ljon shing ltar/ rang gi las kyis grub tshe 'dor ba'i nus pa ma mchis pa 40)'di ni yid shin tu skyo ba'i gnas te/ bdag gi rnam thar gyi ngo bo ni de lta bu las ma 'das so/ yang rang lo nyer gcig pa'i tshe skyabs gnas dam pa rig 'dzin chen po 'ja' tshon snying po grwa tshang du spyan drangs te/ kho rang gi gter chos rnams dang*/ gzhan yang dbang chos dpag tu med pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang zhing*/ de'i tshe/ yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi dbang gi skabs su bum dbang grub phral yud tsam spyan nam mkha' la gzigs shing dgongs pa la bzhugs nas/ dar cig na bdag la 'di skad gsungs te/ khyod ni gter kha gong 'og mang po zhig nas lung gis kyang zin pa yin zhing*/ khyad par rdzogs chen sogs zab khrid kyi sgo nas 'gro don chen po 'grub par 'dug

da lta bdag gi gsal snang la khyed ni shel gyi mchod rten 'od 'phro ba gcig tu gyur nas 'dug 41)pa'i bum pa'i thad kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du karma rabs brgyad rnams zhal phyir gzigs te chos kyi sgra sgrog par mthong*/ zhes gsungs shing*/ bdag la thugs rjes dgongs pa rtse gcig tu gtad nas lugs gnyis ka nas 'khor ba med pa'i sku drin gyis bskyang bar mdzad do/ de'i skabs su bdag cag rnams lho phyogs yangs pa'i rgyal khams kyi sa'i thig le bka' brgyud kyi gdan sa chen po dpal gyi gro bo lung gi sras mkhar sprul pa'i pho brang chen por/ rje btsun dam pa dpal gtsug lag rgya mtsho mjal ba la phyin te/ sku drung du slebs ma thag pha bu phrad pa ltar gyur zhing sku drin zla med du bskyangs te/ bka' chos kyi sgo du ma nas yid kyi re ba rdzogs par mdzad cing*/ khyad par du bstan pa'i gzhi ma 'dul ba'i sde snod las/ thog mar dge ba dge bsnyen/ bar du dge ba dge tshul/ tha mar dge ba dge slong gi 42)bslab pa yongs su rdzogs par stsal bar gyur/ slob dpon rin po che karma legs pa'i drung du yang theg pa chen po'i gzhi rten dam par gyur pa byang chub sems bskyed kyi bslab pa smon 'jug don dam thams cad yongs su rdzogs par zhus/ lho brag skor gyi gnas mjal rnams legs par grub cing*/ rim pas gtam shul dang btsan gro phyogs su phyin te gnas gzhi bkra shis rab brtan du/ gu ru rin po che chos kyi dbang phyug gi gdung rab brgyad pa/ chos kyi rje 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin grags pa'i drung du/ zhi khro bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs dang*/ bla ma'i thugs sgrub gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa'i dbang lung mang du zhus/ slar gdan sa chen po sna bo lcog por mnga' bdag gi gdung rabs bcu gsum pa'i drung du'ang bka' chos phran bu thob cing*/ de nas rim gyis dbus phyogs kyi sgrub gnas rnams kyang bde bar 'khor zhing*/

khyad par bsam yas su sleb pa'i nyin/ bdag cag 43)rnams dang bsam yas kyi bar du 'ja'i gur phub pa la sogs pa'i dge mtshan kyang byung zhing*/ rim pas dbus phyogs kyi gnas mjal legs par grub/ lar gnas rnams la phyin dus 'ja' zug pa 'di shin tu mang bar byung ba/ 'byung ba'i byer sdud kyi 'du 'phrod la mtshan mar 'dzin pa blun po'i rtags su nges mod kyang*/ dus bzang la gnas chen rnams su byung ba ni byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma yin nam snyam pa'i 'dzin pa byung ngo*/ yang*/ dus lan gcig gi tshe/ mtshams zhig byas nas mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma'i bzlas pa la brtson pa'i skabs shig gi rmi lam 'khrul snang du/ bdag nyid gcig pu lho brag mkhar chu lta bu gcig tu bsdad 'dug tsa na/ mdun du shel gyi ri chen po zur gsum pa shin tu mtho ba sked pa man chad sprin dang na bun 'khrigs pa zhig gi rtse mo na mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma sku mdog dkar mo 44)phyag g.yas ral gri dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ sku stod yan chad na bun gyi bseb nas thon pa zhig mthong bas/ bdag gi bsam pa la lho brag mkhar chu 'di ni/ gu ru rin po ches gsungs pa'i bka' thang du/ mkhar chu dung sgo rta gdong dkar mo'i gnas// zhi ba'i las rnams bsgrub par shis pa yin/ zhes gsungs 'dug kyang*/ 'di ni mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma'i gnas yin par 'dug snyam pa'i mod la gnyid sad do/ de yang dus re zhig tu bdag gi bsam pa la/ lus kyi khang bu 'di ni nad rkyen gyis rtag tu gtses nas bde ba'i go skabs mi gda'/ nam 'chi nges pa med pa'i tshe yud tsam 'di la/ de snga yan chad byas pa thams cad ni tshe 'di snang gi mdun ma kho nas 'das te thal/ da dung 'di lta bu'i ngang la mi tshe bskyel ba mi rigs shing*/ ltar snang gi gzhan don 'di ni rang gzhan gnyis ka phung 45)ba'i 'dun ma sha stag tu 'dug snyam nas/ rang lo nyer gsum pa'i thog tu 'dag sbyar smra bcad kyi dam bca' lo gsum pa gcig bgyis te mchis skabs su/

thugs rje chen po ngan song rang grol gyi sgrub pa byed dus/ sgrub khang la 'ja' zug pa yang yang byung zhing*/ lan zhig nyams kyi snang ba la/ nga rang gi mdun du gter sgrom zhig yod pa'i thad kar thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcig pa rtsa phyag brgyad pa zhig khra lam gyi mthong zhing*/ khyad par rtsa zhal gyi g.yon ma de sku mdog ljang khu khro 'dzum gyi rnams pa can byis pa lo brgyad pa'i tshad tsam zhig bdag la spyan khra hrig hrig gzigs pa mthong bas/ 'di rmi lam yin nam mngon sum yin bsam pa'i brtag dpyad btang gin bsdad pa'i 'phro la yal nas song*/ yang lan zhig gi rmi lam du/ bdag ni rgya gar gyi yul du rgyal 46)po zhig gi bur skyes te/ rang gi nu bo gcig dang bcas 'dug pa la/ pho brang gi phyi rol du ljon shing gi sdong po dag gi drung na mu stegs kyi ston pa ral pa'i thor cog can/ ri dwags kyi lpags pa gyon pa zhig la bdag cag ma bu gsum chos nyan zhing gda' ba las bdag gi pha la lkog tu 'di skad smras te/ rang cag rnams mu stegs pa'i sbyin bdag byed pa 'di mi 'thad/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa la gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas ces bya ba khyad par 'phags pa zhig yod 'dug pas/ de la gsol ba btab cing nang pa'i chos lugs 'dzin pa 'thad/ ces smras pa'i 'phro la gnyid sad cing*/ dus phyis rin po che gter ston la zhus pas/ de 'dra skye ba snga phyi gang rung zhig gi bag chags yin las che yi ger thob gsungs byung bas btab pa yin no/ yang rmi lam zhig tu/ bdag gcig pur chu 'gram zhig tu sdad 'dug tshe/ skyes 47)pa dar sgang ma sha tsa dmar ba gcig gis/ ja spobs rtse 'dra ba'i ko thum can zhig bdag gi mdun du bzhag cing phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad zer te/ bdag ni lha 'dre yin te/ bdag can lha 'dre'i rigs thams cad nyon mongs pa dug gsum la brten nas byung ba yin zhing*/ de'i nang nas bdag ni nyon mongs pa 'dod chags las gyur pa'i rigs su gtogs pa yin zhing*/

bdag gi spun zla nyon mongs pa phrag dog las gyur pa'i rigs su gtogs pa gcig yod pa'i ming la karma don 'grub zer ba yin te/ de shi ba yin pas khyed kyis de la dmigs pas bsngo ba gcig mdzad dgos zer byung tshe bdag gi bsam par/ kho rang zer lugs la ni lha dre thams cad dug gsum la brten nas byung ba yin zer 'dug rung*/ phrag dog dang nga rgyal gnyis bgrang na dug lnga ru 'gyur ba yin pa la bsam pa byung zhing bsngo ba zhig kyang byas/ da ni 'di la skye rgyud 48)dang gnas yul sogs zhib tu dris nas/ skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa zhig kyang phog dgos snyam pa'i mod la gnyid sad do/

gzhan tshe 'das lha 'drer skyes pa'i tshul 'ga' zhig mthong kyang bshad pa'i dgos pa chung zhing shul gyi nye 'brel rnams sems mi bde bar 'gyur bas ma brjod do/ mchan/ de nas lo mtshams kyi bcad rgya grol 'phral du/ mdo khams kaḥthog nas chos kyi rje bla ma blo gros dpon slob rnams phebs pa dang mjal bas/ bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud chen mo sogs kyi chos 'brel zhus shing*/ phar la'ang nyid kyi dgongs bzhed dang mthun pa'i dbang chos phul/ de nas rim gyis kong stod gad pa skya bor/ rig 'dzin chen po sangs rgyas gling pa'i gdung rabs bdun pa/ mtshungs med rig 'dzin snying po'i gong du/ zab chos dgongs pa 'dus pa'i dbang lung yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas gling pa'i gter phran skor dang*/ paṇa chen bi ma la'i zab pa pod bzhi la 49)sogs pa'i chos bka' shin tu mang bar thob/ gzhan yang bla ma dang slob dpon mang dag gi zhabs la reg cing*/ thams cad kyi bdag la sku drin chen pos brtse bskyangs su mdzad cing*/ dbang lung khrid man ngag lag len mtha' dag so so nas rtsal sprugs su gnang ba kho na byung rung*/ rang nyid brtson 'grus kyi stobs shugs chung zhing dkor sgrib kyi 'thums pa'i dbang gis/ rang rgyud smin grol du gyur pa'i yon tan ni lta zhog nyon mongs cung zad kha bri ba tsam yang shin tu dka' ba'i gnas su gyur te// 'on kyang da dung zab mo'i gdams pa zhu ba dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa la chog shes med par mchis so/ sngon dus skal bzang skye bo du ma rnams// dam pa bsten zhing dam chos 'chad nyan dang*// de bzhin sgom sgrub la sogs bya ba kun// spyod srol bzang pos grub thob khyu mang tshogs// da lta rtsod dus gzugs brnyan bstan pa 'dir// rnyed bkur 50)don mi gnyer ba'i chos smra ba// nyin skar las dkon 'ga' tsam byung rnams la'ang*// dad par mi byed grong rgyug khyi ltar brnyas// rnyed dang bkur bsti grags pa don gnyer zhing*// zas gos gtam gyis gzhan mgo bskor byed pa'i// kha gsag can gyi bla gzugs 'dzin pa rnams// 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser bzhin mchog tu brim// tshul 'dir bsam na shes ldan skyes bu dag

ri gling nags khrod dben pa'i bas mtha' ru// tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam pa'i brtul zhugs kyis// rang gzhan don mchog bsgrub na legs bsam snyam/ rang nyid skyes pa nas bzung ste lo nyer drug gi che bar gyi spyod tshul rnams rag rim brjod pa'i le'u gnyis pa'o/ gang zhig 'gro la rjes chags brtse ba can// sdug bsngal mnar la sman mdzad mgon po mchog /thugs rje rmad byung zla 'dra'i mdog mnga' zhing*// phyag 51) na pad dkar 'dzin pa des skyongs shig kye ma kong rong thib po'i smag nang du// dge blo srin bu'i snang ba tsam ldan bdag snga 'gyur bstan pa'i snying po rin chen 'di// mun nang stor la skyo bas yid pham yang*// thos bsam sgom 'bras snang bas 'phongs pa'i phyir// log lta'i mig sman gzhom par mi nus pas// 'od ma'i khang bur 'dag sbyar smra bcad dang*// gsol 'debs tsam gyi dge sbyor 'bad bzhin gnas// de tshe phyogs dus rgyal ba'i thugs rje yi// dbyings nas 'gro la phan bde'i 'od stong can// ngag gi dbang phyug gzhan phan rdo rje'i mtshan// mkhyen brtse mtshungs med nam mkha' nor bu'i zer// 'gro la 'char byed skya rengs bya ma rta// ngo mtshar snyan ngag rgyu skar 'phreng ba dang*// lhan cig mun pa'i gling 'dir shar ba yis// bdag blo'i chu skyes ze'u 52)'bru gsal bar gyur// blang dor tsa ko ra yi mig can dag snang byed pho nya la dga'i blo bral yang*// dam chos nam mkha'i nor bu blta 'dod byi'u// dga' ba'i nam langs mkha' la 'phur bar brtsam// 'on kyang nad ldan sman mi shes pa'i byis// kha ba'i ro la byol yang brtse ba'i mas// kha zas dang sbyar sbyin 'dra'i thabs dag dang*// ma ldan don mi 'grub mthong bag phebs byas// kye hud sngon tshe chos rgyal byang sems kyis// mi 'phangs gser la byas nas brdzangs tshul la// deng sang chos la skyob cing bsrung thabs kyi// yan lag mchod skor brtson 'di rigs sam ci// nyal 'gro g.yas su 'khyil ba'i sum brtsen gnas// lhag bsam lang tshos brgyan pa'i lha yi bu// 'ga' la zab chos me tog 'phreng ba yis// klubs nas dge blos mdzes pa'i thabs kyang bgyis// de nas dbo yi zla ba'i

53)tshes bcu'i tshe// yid kyis shing rta gyen du kha bsgyur nas// pha rol phyin pa'i grangs ldan grogs dang bcas// chos don gnyer ba kho na'i bsam pas chas// de tshe bdag gi lhag bsam rab dkar la// dga' ba'i pad tshogs ze'u 'bru'i 'dzum mdangs ston// sa 'dzin rnams ni dar dkar thod kyang phud// myu gu'i tshogs kyang sa las mngon 'phags nas// spro bas mgrin pa bsring zhing lang tsho ston// mkha' las legs so'i 'brug sgra grags bzhin pas// mu tig chun bu'i char rgyun skyes su brdzangs// bla ma zang zing rin du sprod mkhas pa'i// 'di nang don chen gnyer ba'i tshong pa dag zong dang bral ba'i gyur byed ngang tshul gyi// rnam 'gyur dga' ba las gzhan du ma ston// chos brgyad 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid kyi// a wa le pa'i mnga' thang mi ldan kyang*// rang dbang mngon du spyod 54)pa'i yid bzhin nor// ldan des phyi bshol rgud bas ma mnar tsam// nyon mongs zhugs la 'chol ba'i bud shing bsnan// lha chen rnam thar kho nas dus 'da' yang*// dad rdzas ched du mkhas btsun bzang po'i tshul// ston mkhas de dag ngag la bdag ma nyan// dkon pa'i mchog dang dkar po'i lha rnams kyis// mthu las lam gyi nyer 'tshe'i rigs mtha' dag bral bzhin drin can pha de'i zhal dkyil zla// nam zhig mthong bar 'gyur gyi re ba dong*// kong rong yul srid 'tsho ba'i gsal lha pas// mthun rkyen du mas yid kyi re ba bskangs// 'byor ldan gnod mdzes mkhar 'dzin ma dang bus// lam du dbul ba sel ba'i cha rkyen sbyar// sgyu lus 'tsho byed yo byad 'byor bzhin du// yul dang grong brdal myul zhing dkor zas la// chags na zab don nor bu mi lon snyam// ri dwags rmas 55)pa'i brtul zhugs kho nas bgrod// mtho zhing dben pa'i ming can gang de dag bsam gtan gling sogs longs spyod pad+ma'i mtshor// chags med mkha' la 'phur ba'i ngang pa'i tshogs// dol thang dar dkar brgyangs 'drar 'byor pa'i tshe// thugs rje'i gter chen dpal ldan bla ma des// shul ring nyam thag mgron po dbugs 'byin phyir// mthun rkyen du mar bcas pa'i pho nya ba// snyan ngag mdzes pa'i ba dan 'phyar ba dang*// 'dzom tshe dngos dang rmi lam som nyir gyur// dmus long dmigs bu rnyed 'dra'i dga' ba dang*// bde ldan spyod pas nyin tshan 'da' bzhin du// dpal dang 'byor pas brgyan pa'i de 'ur slob// 'dod yon lha yi dpal la 'phya bzhin du// ma chags rnam 'dren de drung rings snyegs mthus// zla gcig nyin zhag gsum gyi snga dro nas// tshong pa rin chen gling du slebs mtshungs gyur/

56)/lkog gyur dri med gzigs pa'i mgon po zhes// lhun grub chos sdings gong ri'i yang dben du// rnam 'dren nor bu'i 'phreng ba dkrigs pa'i dbus// mdo 'dzin dam par bzhugs pas mngon gshegs te// zla 'od gzhon nus rin chen brtson 'grus dang*// thams cad grol gyis bram ze slong ma'i yid// re ba bskong phyir mdun nas bsu mdzad ltar// 'ongs pa legs zhes dbugs dbyungs tshim par mdzad// deng sang ming snyan bla mar btags pa phal// chos 'dod dbul tshogs bye ba phrag brgya las// nor ldan 'bul nod gcig nyid kho nar dgyes// rgyu des tshul mthun 'chad nyan rab tu dkon// zang zing dgra dang dkor zas dug nyid du// mkhyen gzigs chos min spyod la rab sdang ba'i// dpa' bo khyod kyi mdzad mtshung chos spyod gzhan// mdzad na chos brgyad dgra sde ci phyir chags// mgon de'i zhal gyi zla snang mthong tsam la// 'dir snang 57)zhen pa bsra 'thas rdo rje'i brag bde blag nyid du gzhom pa'i nus ldan thog thugs rje'i dpal ldan de las gzhan su zhig dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo gsungs pa'i tshes// dge ldan nag zla'i snga dro dang po la// mtha' 'khob shul ring lam nas 'ongs pa'i mi// kho bo'i bsam pa rdzogs pa'i dga' ston thob// gong ra'i kun dga' ra ba'i me long ngos// gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor brgya phrag mngon 'char bas// lhun grub 'od gsal don gyi dkyil 'khor mchog mtshon mdzad rnam 'dren mchog de'i grub rtags dngos// ngan song nas drangs lha mi'i theg pa nas// blo 'das rdzogs chen theg pa'i rtse rgyal bar// smin grol 'jug sgo'i chu bo kun gzhol ba'i// dbang mchog chu gter bdag gi skal bar thob// deng sang sgrub phran sna re'i smin byed kyi// khrid la rdza mkhan 'khor lo'i dbu mnga' ba'i/ 58)/bla chen gar dbyangs rol mo'i dpung ldan dag mthong tshe rnam 'dren mchog de lhag par dran// snga 'gyur rgyud sde 'bum gyi glegs bam mchog

sngon med ngo mtshar yid bzhin nor bu'i phreng*// dag byed byi dor nan tan dang lhan cig /re ba las kyang lhag pa'i 'dod dgu thob// smin dbang grol khrid rgyud lung man ngag chos// mnga' dbang phyug pa dam pa'i chos nyid la// mtshar ci de bas nyin tshan bar ma chad// ngal bral chos char 'bebs pa 'di ches 'phags// 'ga' zhig thos shes min yang grags phyir tshong*// la la shes kyang mi nus khong 'drul byed// kha cig 'on pa'i rol mo mkhan mtshungs pa// rnam mang kho nas snying bstan 'dam du bsgrub// ngag gi dbang phyug de lta'i rnam par thar// deng sang chen por grags pa rnams kyi rnar// brnyad na khron pa'i sbal la rgya mtsho'i khyon// brjod 59)mtshungs mngon sum 'gyur bar gor ma chags// zang zing 'bul la dam chos mi 'tshong ba'i// mdzad bzang de yang sngon dus bai ro yis// rje la theg pa'i rgyal po nam mkha' che// dud 'gro'i rgyal po rtar mi tshong gsungs dang*// mtshungs las khyad par deng sang zang zing ched// chos 'gyed gtong pa'i dus 'di lhag par 'phags// kye ma so sngags tsam gyi gdams phran la'ang*// gser gyi rin thang byed na tshe gcig gis// sangs rgyas sbyor la stong gsum bye brag brgya// nor bus bkangs kyang de la ci ltar byed// bka' gter zab chos rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa// sngon chad phyogs 'dir ming tsam ma grags pa'i// tshig don bcud kyis btams pa'i 'dab brgya pa// bdag sogs rkang drug tshogs kyi dpal du shar// de tshe nag po'i phyogs rnams ma bzod dang*// 'gro ba'i 60)sdig 'bras smin gnyis 'dzom pa'i mthus// mi bzad du ru ka yi dpung tshogs kyis// gtsang dbus yar 'brog mtha' dag khyabs par gyur// bden bral mngon sum 'byung 'dra'i ngang tshul gtam// thos tshad tsit+ta'i shun pa 'gas byed cing*// mthong tshad lnga par 'god pa'i mthu dpung gis// skye 'gro du ma duḥkha'i gnas la bkod// grangs mang gzhon pa'i rdog sgra kho nas kyang*// sa kun 'ur ches g.yo ba'i shugs ldan zhing*// 'khrul ldan me mda'i sgra chen gcig pus kyang*// ri brag brnyil zhing 'thor ba'i cho 'phrul ston// de tshe 'gro kun rab skrag rtab rtab por// gyur cing rnam par 'gyur ba du ma zhig

spyod kyang mgon de'i thugs rje'i nyi 'od las// log 'dren 'ug pa'i tshogs kyis nye ma nus// sngon tshe byams pa'i stobs kyi bsod nams mthus// yul khams kun la sha zas 61)gnod ma nus// de bzhin gzhan phan rdo rje'i mtshan don dang*// mthun pa'i byin rlabs mthu yis bdag sogs skyabs// zla ba bco brgyad nyin dang mtshan mthar thug dam chos 'dod dgu'i char phabs zas gos bskyangs// dgos dgu'i glegs bam grangs med zang zing bcas// bstsal 'di rgyal srid gtad pa'i do zla min// tha snyad rig pa'i gnas kyi gzhung lugs la// bdag blo 'jug pa'i brtson 'grus shes rab blo// mi ldan mod kyang rje de'i byin rlabs zer// phog pas cha shas tsam yang skal bar thob// rang nyid thos bsam sgom pa'i nus bral zongs// bster yang gzhan phan mdangs 'byung min mod kyang*// bla ma'i bka' drin rin chen su war+ṇa// bkye mthus rgyal mtshan rtse mor bkod rung tsam// de yang mos pa'i rmang gzhi legs brtan zhing*// shes rab gsum gyi ba gam gsar pa can/ 62)/blo gros sgo mang ldan pa'i khang bzang las// 'jag khyim tshang tshing grong la ci zhig dgos// bla gos 'od zer 'phro ba sna tshogs kyis// legs brgyan gre ba bde 'jam glu dbyangs dag len mkhas nor rdzas 'gugs pa'i nus ldan gyi// mkhas grub min tshe gzhan don ga la 'grub// mdzes chos kai la sha ri mngon mtho'i ngogs// zang zing chu klung rgyun 'bab nyams dga' bas// stong nyid snod ldan ri dwags gzhon nu'i sde// skyong mkhas ngo mtshar de 'dra'ang bdag la med// bsam bzang phyi nang gsal ba'i grwa chung nang*// zab dgu'i gdams ngag pod chung gcig kho na// mchis 'di rang gzhan kun gyi spyi nor du// bya snyam nor dang grags phyir ci la ston// tsan+dan sdong po mi brim tshong 'dus su// sol ba rin thang che yang btsong des ci// bong sha ri dwags rnga mas brid btsong na// brim par mngon yang de 'dras bdag mi

63)mgu// 'phral don rnam rtog nad zug can dga' ba'i// srung zlog gsad pa'i sman dang ma ldan zhing*// rnam mang shes bya'i gso rig ma sbyangs pas// mkhas pa'i snyan grags thob pa ga la srid// de lta mod kyang rnying bstan rin chen mchog skyong phyir gzhan dag su ma mgu na yang*// rang nyid kho na 'bad par dam pa des// bka' stsal spyi bor len par dam yang bcas// gangs can mkhas grub gtsug rgyan klong chen zhabs// 'gro la brtse bas slar yang sku sprul pa'i// dam pa mchog des zab chos 'ga' yi rgyun// spel slad lho brag phyogs su shog gsungs kyang*// mi zad rims dang mtha' mi'i gnod 'tshe la// 'dzem pas re zhig bsgrod par ma gyur mod// gu ru'i sgrub gnas shangs kyi zab bu lung*// ngo mtshar pad+mas brgyan pa'i 64)mtsho chen du 'jug par 'dod kyang gnas skabs dus dbang gis// ma nus ngang mo rang gi skyon du zad// rang lus phung khams rgyal ba'i zhing rab 'byams// rig rtsal lha dang bla ma'i rol pa ru// ma shes ri brag ltad mo blta 'dod kyi// zhen pa'i rjes phyir 'brel ba'ang gad mo'i gnas// de nas khrums gyi zla ba'i dkar tshes la// mun gling chos kyi sgron 'khyer dā ri 'dra'i// bskyel thung kho nar dam pa de yang gshegs// chos la sgang du mnga' bdag mar pa yis// mi la rje la ji ltar gdams bzhin du// 'di bzung byang chub bar gyi blang dor gnas// snying gtam gdams ngag snying la phan pa'i gsung*// du mas bdag blo'i re ba rdzogs par mdzad// yar 'brog dpal gyi de'u bsod nams gter// dbang sgyur dad 'byor gdengs can dbang po gang*// dgyes phyir zab chos me tog chu 'phyang dag lhag bsam 65)dri bzang 'phro ba'i mgun rgyan phul// yul dbus dar rgyas chos sdings pad+ma'i tshal// mdzes byed sprul pa'i sku mchog u dum war// snyan grags dri bsung ma la ya rlung gis// yid 'phrog glu dbyangs dar dir mang blangs kyang*// zab chos sbrang rtsi'i 'dod pa ma thob pas// yid skyo'i bung ba skyo glu len bzhin song*// e rong 'chad dkar bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dbus// zla bral theg brgyad bang rim mngon mtho'i rtser// zab bcud rdzogs chen rnam rgyal khang bzang la// dbang bsgyur mchog de'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod// blta 'dod ti ser 'gran pa'i ri bo'i rtser// legs bsgrod chos kyi gtam gyis bdag yid tshim// dwags kong rnying ma'i rdor gdan rtse le ru// rang gzhan phan 'dod phyin par rab rtsams kyang*// mi bzad rdo rje'i tsher mas lam bcad de// yid kyi 'dod pa cung zad

66)'grub ma gyur// rang gi lus srog skyed byed drin can gnyis// bgrang gzhi'i 'khur lci zug rngu'i nad kyis gdung*// nyam thag gyur la yid kyi ma bzod nas// sems dang bstun pa'i phan thabs ci nus bgyis// lung bstan nags khrod bde chen bsam 'grub tu// bla mas 'dod dgu'i sne len phun tshogs stsal// rim gyis chu klung g.yas su 'khyil ba'i gnas// gang der phyed gnyis lo la bde bar 'khor// lam ring kun tu rab 'jigs 'brum nad kyis// gdung ba'i skye bos gang zhig dbugs bral tshogs// gram ltar brdal bas gzur med kho na'i dbus// bsgrod rung dri tsam ma gos bla ma'i drin// 'ga' zhig zang zing ched du lus dang srog gtan gyi 'dun mar bcas pa gtong nus na// kho bo dam chos kho na'i ched nyid 'dir// sgyu ma'i lus tsam bor yang ci lto snyam// 'on kyang da dung zab chos 67)sha stag cig /nyams su len pa nyin skar ltar mchis kyang*// 'chad dang nyan pa'i srol ka ma nub tsam// tshe lhag ji tsam thub par bya'o snyam// drin can bla ma'i zhal ras gsal lam lam// bstan cing zab rgyas chos kyi gsungs lhang lhang*// stsal ba'i bka' drin da dung dran lam lam// mos gus gdung bas gsol 'debs dbyangs lhang lhang*// rgyun ldan bod la rgyun du brtser dgongs nas// rab zab chos sgo rab 'byams mtha' yas pa'i// smin grol gdams pas smin pa'i thugs rje ni// bdag sogs 'gro la bdag nyid khyod kyis stsol// dpal skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po'i drung du zab chos kyi dga' ston du gnyer ba thob pa'i tshul brjod pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// ༈ rgyal kun thugs rje ye shes lha lam las// zab gsal stong nyid snying rje'i dbyar rnga ldir// smin grol zab 68)mo'i sbrang char 'bebs mdzad pa'i// rnam 'dren phreng bar dkrigs pas dge legs stsol/ kye ma/ snyigs las ches snyigs rtsod dus tha ma 'dor// long bas long 'khrid bla ma'i ming khral babs// bdag dang bdag 'dra'i tshul 'dis 'gro phan ni// shin tu dka' mod 'on kyang mos blo tsam// 'bad pas btsal ba'i dam chos ni// drin can bla ma mchog rnams kyis// brtser dgongs zab chos rin chen nor// 'ga' tsam rang skal thob tshul brjod// gzhan du bdag gi rtogs brjod rnam par thar// ngo mtshar rnam grangs gang yang bstan rgyus dben// de slad gdams pa thob tshul sa bon tsam// 'di ni ngo mtshar snying po bkod pa lags// 'di dag rang che 'dod dang zang zing dang*// grags dang snyan pa bsgrub slad ma yin te// skye dang skye bar rang gzhan phan phyir nyid// kho na bsam las thos tshul 'di ltar lags//

༈ de yang khams gsum chos 69)kyi rgyal po dpal gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i zhabs drung du/ bstan pa rin po che la rab tu byung ba'i bslab pa gsum las dang por dge ba dge bsnyen/ bar du dge ba dge tshul/ tha mar dge ba dge slong gi sdom pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang ston pa'i 'khrungs rabs brgya rtsa/ zhi ba lha'i bslab btus/ bka' gdams glegs bam yongs rdzogs dang*/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha lnga pa'i gtor dbang zhing bkod mar grags pa dang*/ 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes gnang*/ tshes bcu'i gtor dbang*/ grub thob shangs pa nas brgyud pa'i mgon po phyag drug pa'i gtor dbang bar chad kun sel/ phag mo'i lha khrid/ rje btsun mi tra nas brgyud pa'i snying po don gsum gyi khrid dang*/ rje btsun dam pa dpal gtsug lag 'phreng ba'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs po sti bco lnga rnams kyi ljags lung bka' gtad dang bcas pa thob/ ༈ gter ston pad+ma rig 'dzin rtsal gyi 70)drung du/ khong rang gi gter chos bla ma nor bu pad phreng gi dbang lung bka' gtad yongs rdzogs dang*/ rig 'dzin zhig po gling pa'i gter chos kyi tshe sgrub rgyal ba 'dus pa/ gu ru zhi ba/ bla ma drag po gtum drag me 'khor dang gnam lcags me 'khor/ thugs rje chen po 'khor ba las sgrol/ dpal bde mchog 'khor lo/ rta mgrin nā ga klu 'dul/ phyag rdor stobs po che/ zab pa skor bdun/ rdzogs chen gsang ba snying thig mtha' dmag bzlog pa'i chos skor/ snang rtse ba'i bka' 'bum thor bu dang*/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyud lung nyi shu rtsa lnga/ zhi khro gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi skor kha thor/ myang gi gter mgon phyag bzhi'i chos skor cha tshang gi dbang lung sogs thob/ ༈ rig 'dzin chen po 'ja' mtshon snying po'i drung du/ de nyid kyi gter chos tshe sgrub gnam lcags rdo rje/ thugs rje chen po ngan song ral grol/ yang zab dkon mchog 71)spyi 'dus/

gsang lam bla sgrub/ zhi khro ngos don snying po/ rta phag yid bzhin nor bu/ lam yig pad+ma dkar po/ dpal mgon ma ning nag po sogs mdor na gter chos yongs rdzogs dang*/ rnam thar phyi nang gsang gsum gyi skor thob/ gzhan yang*/ snying ma rgyud 'bum kha thor tsam dang*/ mi tra brgya rtsa dang sgrub thabs rgya mtsho/ bde mchog lha lnga dang*/ phag mo bden gnyis zhal gyi dbang*/ rdor gling gi gter chos rdzogs chen lta ba klong yangs/ hūm̐ skor snying thig drag po dmar chung*/ bai ro'i 'dra 'bag gter ma/ mnga' bdag myang gi gter chos gu ru drag po dmar chen/ mkha' 'gro khros nag 'jam dpal nā ga rak+sha/ drang srong log tri char kha gdong zor/ lha mo spyang zhon ma'i sgrub skor sogs dang*/ gu ru'i thugs sgrub dang*/ rnam thar zangs gling ma sogs thob/ chos dbang gi bka' 'bum dang na ga rak+sha/ chos drug sras mkhar ma/ kun skyong gling pa'i snying po snying tig byang gter gyi rdzogs chen dgongs pa zang thal/ thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun grol/ bshad rgyud/ o rgyan gling pa'i gter 72) chos pad+ma thang yig chen mo dang*/ bka' thang sde lnga/ dri med lhun po'i gter ma don tig 'gro ba kun grol dang*/ zab tig dgongs pa rang grol/ tshe sgrub rdzogs chen ma/ snying khrag thig le le'u lnga pa/ zhang khrom gyi tshe bdag lcags sdig king kang dmar chung*/ yang zlog me yi spu gri/ ngag 'khrol dang sku gsum za yig sogs dang*/ ༈ pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyi gter ma gnyan po lha gsum/ kha la rgyas 'debs/ bza' bdud dang zhing skyong gi sgrub skor/ grwa pa mngon shes kyi gter ma 'dzam lha dmar po dang*/ zhang blon rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi sgrub skor srung ba drag po bzhi dril sogs dang*/ gter ston sar paṇa phyogs med du grags pa'i gter ma 'jam dpal rdzogs chen/ sangs rgyas gling pa'i gter ma gu ru drag po/ dri med kun dga'i gter ma bla rdzogs thugs gsum tshang ma dang*/

gter ston bka' 'bum dang*/ mtsho rgyal gyi rnam thar chen 73)mo/ nyi zla sangs rgyas kyi gter ma kha la rgyas 'debs/ chos rgyal rin chen gling pa'i gter ma zab chos nor bu skor lnga tshang ma dang*/ rnam thar bka' 'bum/ 'gro mgon dung mtsho ras pa'i gter ma rdzogs chen yang ti nag po/ sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu/ trag shad shog dril bcu gsum/ rig 'dzin rat+na gling pa'i gter ma thugs sgrub yang snying 'dus pa/ tshe sgrub/ thugs rje chen po/ rta mgrin/ zab lam ste/ 'dus pa skor lnga tshang ma/ gu ru drag po/ tshes bcu'i phan yon/ phur pa yang gsang bla med/ ma ning rnam mang dmar po/ dam can sgrub skor sogs dang*/ gter ston pad+ma gling pa'i rdzogs chen kun bzang dgongs pa kun 'dus/ phyag rdor dregs 'dul/ gu ru drag po dmar chen/ gnyal smad mdo sngags gling pa'i rdzogs chen kun 'dus rgya mtsho/ rje rin chen phun tshogs kyi zab chos 74)dgongs pa yang zab/ yid bzhin nor mchog rnam thar bka' 'bum dang bcas pa/ g.yu thog snying thig sdug bsngal mun sel gso dpyad kyi rgyud bzhi man ngag bye ba ring bsrel dang bcas pa/ karma gu ru'i sgrub skor/ rlung 'khor dregs pa nyi shu/ klu sgrub kyi rgya nag chu 'khor/ kha 'bar ma'i gtor chog phyag rdor u tsār+ya'i chos skor/ paṇa chen nags rin gyi pad+ma tshe khrid/ sa skya pa nas brgyud pa'i khro rgyal rme brtsegs kyi sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba'i mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma'i skor/ mi tra nas brgyud pa'i thugs rje chen po'i gsang sgrub dang*/ mi tra khrid drug blo sbyong don bdun ma/ bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi dbang*/ thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i chos skor/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa'i rta mgrin/ byang sems zla rgyal nas brgyud pa'i rta mgrin/ zhi ba lha'i spyod 'jug 75) jo bo'i chos chung brgya rtsa/ phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor dang lnga ldan/

bsre ba 'bum dkar 'bum nag snying po nā ro chos drug lab sgron gyi gcod yul/ o rgyan pa'i rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub/ bde mchog snyan rgyud gsar rnying*/ zab chos khrid brgya'i bskor/ chos rgyal srong btsan bka' 'bum/ jo bo'i byang chub lam sgron gzhung 'grel/ 'brom gyi mi chos gnad phreng*/ pu to pa'i dpe chos rin chen spungs pa/ jo bo'i lam yig chen mo/ rje btsun mi la'i mgur 'bum chen mo/ mnyam med zla 'od gzhon nu'i bka' 'bum cha tshang*/ ras chung bka' 'bum/ phag gru dang stag lung thang pa chen po'i bka' 'bum/ zhang bka' brgyad ma la sogs bka' 'bum cha tshang*/ 'bri gung skyob pa rin po che'i dgongs gcig rtsa 'grel/ rgyal dbang karma pa dus mkhyen nas rje dgu pa yan 76)gyi bka' 'bum phal mo che dang*/ dpal mkha' spyod pa spyan snga rin po che/ gar dbang dkon mchog yan lag rnams kyi bka' 'bum/ grub thob gling ras/ rgya ras/ rgod tshang pa/ lo ras yang dgon pa/ rtswa ri ras chen/ 'ba' ra ba/ grub thob mgon ye/ rgyal sras thogs med/ grub thob a re dga' phyi ma/ mdo kha ras pa/ rje dbus smyon/ chos bzang nyi ma/ rgyal dbang rje/ mi pham pad dkar lha brtse ba/ rgyal dbang lhun grub/ rgya ston chos bzang*/ sgam po bkra shis rnam rgyal nor bu rgyan pa sogs kyi rnam thar bka' 'bum/ mtshungs med sūr+ya tsan+d+ra'i bka' 'bum rgya mtsho dgu skor/ kar lugs dang 'brug lugs sgam po pa sogs kyi chos spyod rab gsal/ drung pa ku cor bas mdzad pa'i bka' rgyud gser phreng*/ ra lo na ro nas brgyud pa'i 'jigs byed skor/ bka' gdams kyi gri gug gtso 'khor dang*/ rga 77)lo'i phyag bzhi pa/ kar lugs kyi ma mgon/ sa skya'i gur zhal/ bya pa'i spu gri skor gsum/ g.ya' bzang pa'i lha mo dang drang srong skor sogs bstan srung gi skor mang po/ gzhan yang bka' 'gyur sogs mdor no rig 'dzin de nyid kyis gsan na cog thams cad kyis kyang bka' gtad rjes su gnang ba yongs su rdzogs pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du stsal bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin thob bo/

grub mchog bsod nams dbang po'i drung du/ bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i rdzogs chen snying po gser gyi yang zhun phyag chen klong yangs mtha' bral/ zab mo bdud kyi gcod yul dang bcas pa'i khrid chen gsum ga'i nyams khrid zhib rgyas dang*/ kun skyong gling pa'i gter ma rdor sems snying tig las 'brel rtsal gyi mkha' 'gro snying tig mkhas pa klong chen pa'i bla ma yang tig 78)zab mo yang tig ḍāk+ki yang tig grub thob karma gling pa'i bar do thos grol gyi skor dang bcas pa rnams kyi dbang lung khrid ngo sprod lag len zhal gdams dang bcas pa mtha' dag yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ tshem bu pa nas brgyud pa'i dam khrid/ ston pa'i skyes rabs/ las 'brel rtsal gyi phyag rdor dregs 'dul/ bstan bcos rin po che mdzod bdun dang ngal gso skor gsum sogs klong chen pa'i gsung 'bum kha 'thor thob bo/ drin can ma hā lo tsā ba ngag dbang gzhan phan rdo rje'i drung du/ 'dus pa mdo dbang chen mo yongs su rdzogs pa/ zhi khro na rag dong sprugs kyi dbang*/ sgyu 'phrul zhi ba'i tshe dbang chen mo sogs mdor na dkyil 'khor chen mo mdun cu rtsa lnga dus gcig tu zhal phyes te/ de dag gi smin grol byin rlabs bka' gtad yongs rdzogs phyag bzhes ji bzhin ma nor mngon sum 79)du gtan la phabs te sku drin du stsol bar mdzad/ gzhan yang*/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi rgyud 'bum pod chen bzhi bcu zhe bzhi rnams kyi ljags lung yi ge na gcig kyang ma lus par gnang ba dang*/ ༈ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa/ myang gter gyi pad+ma lam rim/ ༈ chos dbang gi gter ma'i bla ma yongs rdzogs gsang ba grub chen gyi skor/ kha 'bar dkar nag khra gsum/ ༈ rig 'dzin rgod ldem can gyi bka' brgyad rang byung rang shar/ phur pa che mchog dang lcags khang ma gnyis/ thugs sgrub chen mo/ ༈ rig 'dzin gdung sgrub/ las 'brel rtsal gyi bla ma spyi 'dus 'khor lo/

gza' bdud kyi skor/ gnod sbyin dmar nag gi sgrub skor/ ༈ rat+na gling pa'i zab chos klong gsal snying tig gza' sgrub/ bka' srung khros nag gsang ba rag gdong gi las rgyud chen mo/ ༈ pad+ma gling pa'i 80)bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho/ klong gsal gsang ba yang bcud/ yang gsang rgyud bu chung*/ bka' brgyad thugs kyi me long*/ thugs rje chen mo mun sel sgron me/ tshe khrid nor bu lam khyer/ phur pa/ sman sgrub/ rta mgrin dpa' gcig bka' srung dang mngon spyod kyi skor/ ༈ gter ston bstan gnyis gling pa'i bla ma byin rlabs kun 'dus/ yang dag dgongs 'dus/ tshe sgrub srog 'dzin kun 'dus dang*/ tsit+ta'i rgya can gnyis/ rdzogs chen/ phyag chen/ gcod yul/ dus 'khor/ bon khrid/ bka' srung drag sngags dang 'joms byed/ 'od gsal thig le nyag gcig rgyab chos rgyu 'bras phra zhib dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ ༈ gter ston tshe bstan rgyal mtshan gyi gu ru spyan mang sgrub skor/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i gter ma rtsa gsum dril sgrub kyi chos skor/ ༈ paṇa chen pad+ma dbang rgyal gyi gu ru drag po yang gsang rdo rje 'bar ba dang*/ zab 81)chos pad+ma snying thig mnyam med bsam gtan ma gling pa'i a ti'i skor/ ༈ rig 'dzin nam mkhar spyod pa'i gter ma bla sgrub kyi rtsa ba/ snang rtse ba'i sgrol ma dmar mo dang*/ bka' 'bum/ ༈ rdzogs chen rgyud bcu bdun gyi dbang mo che/ yang ti gser gyi 'bru gcig gi dbang lung nyams khrid dang bcas pa/ 'od gsal sgron ma drug skor/ snyan rgyud rdo rje zam pa/ karma snying thig gsang 'grel phyogs bcu mun sel sogs dri med pa'i bka' 'bum/ ༈ lang lab nas brgyud pa'i phyur pa gcig rgyud la/ dug dbang rdo rje pha lam/ gnub ban nas brgyud pa'i bka' srug brgyad kyi sgrub skor/ bsrugs ba 'dam shod ma/ zhi ba 'tsho nas rgyud pa'i 'od zer dri med kyi skor/ mnyam med sog zlog pa'i bka' 'bum kha thor sogs thob cing*/

gzhan yang tha snyad rig gnas kyi skor phran bu sa bon thos pa thams cad kyang rje 82)'di nyid kyi bka' drin kho na'o/ mtshungs med rig 'dzin snying po'i drung du/ bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i dbang chen dbang phran rgyud lung man ngag dang bcas pa'i phyag bzhes dri ma med pa yongs su rdzogs pa dang lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i zab khrid/ sangs rgyas gling pa'i gter ma'i thugs rje chen po phyi rgyal po lugs/ nang nor bu lugs/ yang gsang bla na med pa/ lam rim 'od kyi drwa ba dang bcas pa/ bka' thang chen mo/ phur sgrub thugs kyi snying khu/ tshe sgrub nyi zla kha sbyor/ mkha' 'gro khros nag dang spyi rgyud rgya mtsho/ phyag rdor khyung gsang ba/ yang kho la rta mgrin lcags ral/ rnam sras gnyis/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas gling pa'i gter phran mtha' dag dang*/ bi ma la'i snying thig zab pa pod bzhi mdzod bdun skor kha yar dang bcas pa thob bo/ gzhan yang zab chos kyi 'brel pa thob pa ni/ ༈ sgam po pa mchog sprul 83)mi pham chos kyi dbang phyug gi drung du/ lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang*/ grub rgyal ma nas brgyud pa'i tshe dbang sogs thob/ ༈ rin po che karma legs pa'i drung du/ theg chen byang sdom gyi cho ga zhib rgyas su stsal ba thob/ ༈ kun mkhyen gsung sprul mchog gi drung du/ klong chen pa'i mgur 'bum sogs thob/ ༈ lho brag sna bo chos rje'i drung du/ bder 'dus kyi rtsa rgyud chen mo'i chos 'brel rgyal po'i bla dpe dngos kyi thog nas zhus/ ༈ gnas bkra shis rab brtan du chos dbang gi gdung rabs brgyad pa'i drung du/ bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs dang*/ bla ma'i thugs sgrub gsang ba 'dus pa/ dpal mgon ma ning chos skor sogs thob/ ༈ sangs rgyas gling pa'i gdung rabs bdun pa karma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin pa'i drung du/ rdzogs chen snying po bsdus pa'i skor zhus/ ༈ 84)chos rje rdzogs chen pa 'od gsal nam mkha' 'brug sgra'i drung du/

byang gter gyi tshe sgrub lcags sdong ma'i dbang thob/ ༈ kaḥthog pad+ma blo gros pa'i drung du/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pod lung bka' gtad dang bcas pa thob/ ༈ chos kyi rje rig 'dzin mchog grub rnam rgyal gyi drung du/ rgyud bcu bdun gyi ljags lung*/ dgongs 'dus kyi don dbang dang*/ byin rlabs gtor ma'i brda dbang*/ tshe khrid rdo rje phreng ba/ 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang*/ chos dbang lugs kyi gur drag gi dbang*/ thugs rje chen po yang snying 'dus pa'i dbang sogs thob/ gu ru o rgyan bstan 'dzin pa la dgongs 'dus tshar gcig pa dang*/ yang snying 'dus pa'i skor gyi ljags lung thob/ bla ma ngag gi dbang po'i drung du/ chos dbang gi drag po'i skor dang*/ sangs rgyas gling pa'i 'jam dpal dkar nag khra gsum/ gshin rje pha rol rgol 'joms/ tshe khrid rdor phreng*/ dam tshig gsal skra sogs 85)mang du thob/ drin can dharma'i mtshan can gyi drung du/ dgongs 'dus kyi pod lung*/ gsang ba snying po'i g.yung 'grel bskang gso chos spyod skor dang*/ man ngag gi skor bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ khong rang gi gang gsan thams cad kyi bka' gtad byin rlabs nan du stsal ba thob pa ste/ mdor na phyi thos bsam dang rig gnas kyi phyogs nas sku drin che ba bdun/ nang gsang sngags lag len gyi phyogs nas sku drin che ba gsum/ don dam pa'i ye shes sangs rgyas lag bcang du ngo sprod pa'i sku drin mchog tu gyur pa gnyis/ thun mong zab chos dbang lung chos 'brel gyi bla ma bco brgyad dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' drin las/ phyogs med kyi chos la mos pa thob cing log lta'i las ngan mi gsog par dal 'byor thob pa don med du ma gyur tsam 'di bdag gi rnam thar gyi bzang shos su rlom mo// ༈ sngon byon 86)grub mchog rig 'dzin mtha' yas kun// dam pa'i zab chos tshigs su bcad pa ni/ gcig tsam ched du lus srog rgyal srid dang*// longs spyod ci mchis btang nas mnyan par mdzad// deng sang bskal mthar skye 'gro las

sgrib tshan// ches 'thug bag chags ngan goms dbang btsan che// bshes gnyen bzang dkon rnyed kyang dad ldan dkon// chos las zan rdog 'dams pa ches cher mang*// bdag ni dam chos dri med sus ston par// mos dang dkon pa'i 'du shes yod na'ang*// skal ba dman mthus rgya cher thos ma gyur// de phyir gang thob chos kyi rnam grangs kyi// mtshan tsam brjod 'di'ang ma rgan 'gro mang 'di'i// ma rig mun pa bsal zhing thar lam gyi// nye rgyu'i sa bon nyid du 'gyur smon pas// tshul 'di yi ge'i lam du bkod pa lags// slad kyi blo gsal skyes bu'i tshogs rnams kyang*// ma nor 87)mtshan ldan bla ma btsal ba gces// rnyed nas 'gyur med gus pas brten pa gces// gdams pa'i bcud len nyams chags med pa gces// gang zhus nyams len thog tu khel ba gces// the tshom sgro 'dogs zhun thar chod pa gces// thos bsam sgom pa'i byas yus med pa gces// nam gzhag gtan 'dun chos kyis bsgrub pa gces// gces pa bdun 'di kho bo'i snying gtam lags// snying gtam gdams ngag sems la bshad bshad kyang*/ rang gi tshe phyed g.yeng ba'i ngang du song*// da nas tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam par shog/ ces drin can gyi rnam 'dren dam pa dag gi drung du zab chos kyi bdud rtsi cung zad thob tshul brjod pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// ༈ da ni bsam pa sems bskyed kyi kun nas blangs te dam pa'i chos kyi sgo nas gzhan phan cung zad bgyis pa'i tshul brjod pa la'ang 88)spyir skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi rnam par thar pa'i brjod bya'i gtso bo nyid du gyur pa ni rang don du thos bsam sgom gsum dang*/ gzhan don du 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi mdzad pa rgya chen pos bstan 'gro'i phan bde sgrubs tshul brjod pa nyid yin na'ang*/ bdag lta bu las nyon gyi phung po dang 'khrul rtog gi yo lang la spyod pa'i rang bzhin kho na'i gnas lugs 'di lta bu'i tshul dang brtul zhugs ni mkhas blun mtha' dag gis mngon sum du gzigs yul du gyur bzhin pa 'di nyid las gzhan pa'i rtogs brjod bya rgyus dben zhing*/

'on kyang gnas skabs kyi rang tshul lhug par ma brjod na bskul ba po yi dgongs pa mi rdzogs tshe/ de tshul 'ga' zhig gleng bar bgyi na/ 'di la yang rang don dang gzhan don gnyis kyi dang po rang don du dben pa bstan tshul ni/ de yang rang lo gzhon nu'i dus nas mi med dben par spro ba 89)zhig ni thog ma nas yod de/ lo gsum bzhi tsam lon pa'i dus nas kyang pha ma dang byis pa zla bo sogs med pa gcig rang du lta stangs byas nas bsdad pa'i dbang gis yul mi rnams kyi sgom chen par 'bod pa dang*/ ri khrod dang brag phug sgom khang sogs mthong ba dang gleng ba sogs kyis yid 'phrog pa dang*/ rgyal ba gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar sogs mthong ba'i tshe yang*/ mdzad pa phrin las gzhan gang las kyang mi med kyi lung stongs su bya btang sha stag gis sgrub pa mdzad rabs rnams la lhag par yid smon zhing*/ de mthus rje btsun mi la dang*/ rgyal ba rmog pa sogs kyi rnam thar dang*/ rgod tshang pa mgon po rdo rje dang*/ rgyal sras thogs med dpal bzang po sogs kyis rang las gzhan gces dang*/ grub mtha'i rigs su gyur tshad la dag snang phyogs med dang*/ bzang ngan 'bring gsum gong du 90)'khur ba'i dam bca' sogs kyi mdzad tshul rnams la ches smon zhing mos pa che bar yod kyang*/ 'khos ka med rung bla tshugs 'dzin dgos pa'i rnam pa dang*/ sku skyer ming du btags nas zang zing 'tshol thabs la tshe phyed 'da' ba zhig byed dgos par sngon las kyi grub tshe 'dor bar dka' ba zhig dang*/ de la brten pas dge sbyor dang sgrub pa'i rigs tshul mthun zhig ni nam yang dka' bar byung la/ 'on kyang mtshams dang bsnyen sgrub kyi thog ma ni/ rang lo bcu gcig gi skabs shig tu tshe khrid rdo rje phreng ba'i gsang sgrub kyi bzlas pa 'bru 'bum zhig btang bas/ rmi ltas kyang bzang bar byung zhing*/ de nas bzung ste mtshams dang bsnyen sgrub kyi rigs gang byed kyang bar chad med pa'i rten 'brel 'grigs/

de nas rim pa bzhin du bsnyen sgrub kyi 'brel pa thos pa la/ thugs sgrub yang snying 'dus pa'i gu ru zhi 91)ba la grangs bsnyen gsum lhag tsam dang*/ yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus la 'bum tsho brgya dang nyer brgyad/ de nyid kyi gu ru drag sgrub la grangs bsnyen bzhi dang*/ mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma la 'bum phrag bcu bdun song tshe/ gong gi le'u gnyis par bshad pa bzhin/ rmi lam na seng gdong ma sku mdog dkar mo zhig gsal bar mthong ngo*/ yang de dus lan zhig nyams kyi snang ba la mdun gyi nam mkhar rgyal chen rnam sras seng ge sngon po la chibs pa khru gang gi tshad tsam zhig yun ring du mthong zhing*/ de nyid bsgrubs na sgrub thag nye ba tsam yong shas kha yang*/ mchog gi dngos grub gcig ma thob na thun mong gi zas nor bsgrub pa la snying po med par bsam nas rtsol bas sgrub pa sogs ma byas/ yang*/ re zhig rgyab mtha' brag phug tu gu ru zhi bsnyen byed tshe gzugs 92)med kyi sgra las badz+ra gu ru'i 'dzab dbyangs dir dir ba rgyun chags su thos pa byung rung*/ gzhan la bshad na zog mthong las mi yong bar bsam nas ma brjod/ 'dag 'byar lo gsum pa'i skabs shig tu thugs rje chen po ngan song rang grol gyi ril bu dang khrus chab la brten pa'i sgrub pa zla ba gsum byas pa'i tshe/ bcu gcig zhal rtsa phyag brgyad pa zhig gsal bar mthong ba dang*/ sgrub pa 'thon pa'i nyin sgrub khang la shar phyogs nas 'ja' kha dog lnga ldan yun ring du zug pa dang*/ de dang dus mnyam du rang gi spang thog rtser bye'u sngar ma mthong ba'i spu mdog 'ja' 'od 'khyug pa gcig gi skad 'gyur rigs mi gcig pa mang po sgrog pa yang byung*/ rtsa gsum gyi bsnyen pa'i skabs kyi tshes brgyad kyi srod yol tsam la gang nas yongs don med par bdag gi steng nas mar la/ 93)nas dkar mo snyim pa gang tsam zhig shar gyi byung ste mgo dang sgal khungs su bab byung ba/

de dus su nyams snang ma byung ste/ rjes sor bsam pas dngos grub kyi ltas su go yang bla brang gi dbu rtser tshe sgrub lcags kyi ri bor bsnyen pa byed tshe/ nyin byed yid la med par mi sus kyang ma khur bar bdag gi mdun du gan spos dri ngad gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa mtho gang tsam zhig rang bzhin du 'bar ba yang byung*/ mdor na 'di 'dra ba'i ya mtshan gyis ltas phran bu mthong ba 'ga' zhig byung rung*/ skye 'gro rnams log par lta ba la ches goms pas/ sngon byon gyi grub thob rnams kyis rtsod med kyi grub rtags nam mkha' la bya bzhin 'phur zhing*/ chu la ngang pa ltar gshegs/ ri brag thams cad zang thal du 'phug pa sogs mdzad pa la yang bskur pa 'debs pa ches mang bar byung na/ bdag 'dra'i 'khrul 94)rtog bzang shar phran bu 'dra ba gzhan la bshad rung sdig gsog gi rgyu las mi yong bar dngos su grub tshe/ mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs kho na khe che bar mthong ngo*/ de ltar gong gi 'phro bzhin bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i rtsa bsnyen tsha ba dmar thag la zlas pa dung phyur them pa zhig bya bar sems kyang rang dbang ma 'dus shing*/ 'on kyang sa ya phyed dang lnga tsam song*/ gu ru drag po yang gsang rdo rje 'bar ba'i rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa bde gshegs yongs rdzogs 'dus pa la/ 'bum phrag bzhi bcu zhe drug ni rang lo so lnga yan la song zhing*/ gzhan yang*/ phyag na rdo rje dregs pa kun 'dul la 'bum phrag nyi shu rtsa gsum/ thugs rje chen po ngan song rang grol la bye ba brgya/ rta mgrin nā ga klu 'dul la 'bum phrag bcu drug tshe khrid rdor phreng la 'bum tsho lnga bcu nga gnyis rnams ni spros bcas bsnyen sgrub kyi bzlas grangs 95)song tshul yin la/ de dag thams cad kyi tshe yang spros med gnas lugs khyab gdal gyi ngang nas sgo gsum rdo rje gsum gyi nges shes dang ma bral tsam dang*/ de nyid kyang rang don yid byed kyi zhon rtog spang nas mkha' khyab mar gyur gyi 'gro ba rnams la phan 'gyur gyi sems bskyed dang ldan ngos nas bgyis pa'i khul ma gtogs/

rang nyid kyi tshe dang longs spyod spel ba'am/ rang la gnod byed zhi thabs sogs kyi 'dun pa ni gtan nas ma byas par gang byung bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rjer bsgom pa ni zhe thag pa nas yod cing*/ spros med rdzogs rim gyi nyams len gdeng tshad 'di dang 'di lta bu mchis so zhes brjod rgyu ni gang yang med de/ de ci'i phyir na/ spyir skal ba dman zhing dkor grib kyis 'thums pa dang*/ khyad par du de dag ni lam rtags kyi 96)yon tan gong du 'phel bar byed pa la dben pa'i gnas su mi tshe dril zhing sgo gsum gyi bya ba dgu phrug su btang ba zhig med thabs med tshe/ bdag 'dra ni rnam par g.yo ba dang grwa 'khor yon bdag gi 'du long la gtan du spyod pa 'di mi 'dod thog tu babs tshe/ lam rtags dang nyams rtogs kyi yon tan 'phel ba'i thabs med pa ni dngos kyis bstan mod cing*/ 'on kyang drin can bla ma'i thugs rje la brten nas dran rig gi ngo bo rkyen dang bsre thub tsam dang*/ rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma bung ba bcud la 'khor ba tsam dang*/ 'od gsal thod rgal gyi mthong snang du thig le stong sgron mkhar sder tsam dgu 'brel du 'char ba dang*/ mun khrid kyi tshe ni rig pa tshad phebs kyi 'char sgo rtsal rdzogs su mthong ba tsam byung ba la/ mdor na rang lo so lnga yan chad du mtshams kyi rigs kun dril lo phyed dang 97)dgu tsam song ba ste/ gang ltar 'di yan chad rang don bsgrubs tshul sa bon tsam brjod pa'o// de nas gzhan don bgyis tshul dngos brjod pa la'ang gnyis te/ yul gong ma rnams la chos kyi mchod pa phul tshul dang*/ 'og ma rnams la chos kyi sbyin pa bgyis tshul lo/ dang po ni/ de yang spyir gzhan la smin grol gyi gdams pa ston par byed pa la bla ma'i mtshan nyid drug ldan dang dgu ldan sogs dgos tshul rgyud sde rnams las gsungs pa ltar gyi yon tan ni sna gcig tsam yang bdag la ma mchis mod kyang*/

rang la sku drin che ba'i bla ma dam pa spyi dang*/ khyad par rig 'dzin chen po 'ja' tshon snying po'i zhal snga nas/ bdag la dgongs pa'i gtad phyogs dang gzhan don gyi re ba cher mdzad de/ de nyid kyi bka' las kyang*/ khyed la chos kyi 'gro don 'byung ba'i lung bstan mang du yod de/ 98) ji skad du/ tshe bsgrub gnam lcags rdo rje'i lung bstan las/ da lta'i spa gor bai ro ni: sprul pa'i 'od zer brgya phrag 'gyed: ma 'ong dwags kong so mtshams su: rdo rje karma'i ming 'chang bas: tshe sgrub zab mo'i 'gro don 'byung: zhes pa dang*/ thugs rje chen po ngan song rang grol las: byang nas karma las dang dar rgyas ming: chos 'di phyogs mtshams yaungs la mched par 'gyur: zhes dang*/ dpal mgon gyi chos 'khor lung byang las: la lung maṇ+ḍal 'dra ba'i sa phyogs nas: mkha' 'gro gnas bzang 'dabs su 'khrungs pa ni: shes rab ming 'dzin gzugs bzang mtshan dpe ldan: ḍāk+ki'i tshogs dpon dge la dad pa'i mi: rnam gsal rigs ldan de la gtad rgya gyis: ces sogs gsungs yod pas 'gro don la dka' tshegs mi yong bas byams snying rje dang sems bskyed smon lam gyi rgya bskyed cing gzhan don 99)la brtson pa'i go cha cher bgo bar gyis shig ces gsungs pa dang*/ de bzhin du/ dpal ma hā lo tsā ba'i zhal nas kyang*/ deng sang snyigs dus kyi sems can bsod nams dang skal ba zhan pa'i dbang gis/ dam chos tshul bzhin ston pa'i bshes gnyen ni rab tu dkon pa'i phyir na/ slob ma'i snod brtags pa sogs las kyang 'brel pa bzang thogs rgya che ba bsod nams che zhing de la'ang gdul bya rnams ni las nyon gyis 'thums shing rmongs pa'i dbang gis zab chos zhu shes pa yang dka' bas/ des na so so'i skal ba dang bstun pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs gang la gang 'tshams par ston pa'i sgo nas spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang khyad par gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa nyams dma' ba 'di lta bu la/
