nyan 'chad sgom sgrub kyis phan thogs rgya gang che zhig byed pa ci nas kyang gal 100)che'o/ zhes sogs nan tan gyi sgo nas bstan pa gtad pa'i tshul mdzad pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ mtshungs med rig 'dzin snying po/ drin can dharma'i mtshan/ mkhas grub pad+ma blo gros sogs thams cad kyis kyang de dang mthun par 'gro don kho na la bskul bar mdzad na'ang*/ rang nyid la thos bsam sgom pa'i nus pa ni dben/ snyigs dus kyi 'gro ba rnams ni dug lnga rags shing rgyud mi srun pas thul bar ni dka'/ zab chos bshad kyang nyams len byed mkhan ni nyin skar las dkon/ gsang sngags kyi chos ni bka' gnyan zhing bka' srung gi mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams ru nga ni dog deng sang gi skye 'gro spyi dang khyad par chos sgor zhugs pa rnams dang grwa slob kyi rigs mtha' dag kyang dam tshig bsrung mi ni med/ rang nyid la gzhan rgyud shes pa sogs snod dang skal bar ldan mi ldan gyi dbye ba shes pa'i nus pa ni med/ de'i 101)phyir gang nas bsam kyang chos kyi 'gro don byed pa'i stobs dang mthu nus yod pa zhig rang la nam yang mi gda' bas sgyid lug cing yid skyo ba zhig las mi 'dug rung*/ 'on kyang rten 'brel gyi babs tshul la brten pa'i/ yul gong 'og rnams la zab chos kyi 'brel pa bgyis tshul ni rang lo bcu'i skabs su gter ston pad+ma rig 'dzin rtsal la tshe khrid rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang lung phul ba 'di ni gzhan la chos bka' 'bul ba'i thog ma yin zhing*/ gzhan yang*/ spo bo gsang sngags chos gling nas sprul pa'i sku mchog rig 'dzin rgya mtsho la bstan bcos shing rta chen po'i lung phul/ gu ru o rgyan bstan 'dzin pa la tshe sgrub rdor 'phreng gi dbang phul/ rig 'dzin chen po 'ja' tshon snying po la sku tshe'i rten 102)'brel la dmigs pa'i tshe sgrub rdor 'phreng dang rgyal ba 'dus pa sogs kyi tshe dbang brgya tshar du ma dang*/

gzhan yang bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs skor dang*/ dgongs 'dus dbang 'thor sogs dang*/ mdor na mdo khang rgyud 'bum sogs rang gi gangathob kyi chos skor so so'i bka' gtad sogs dgongs bzhed dang mthun par phul/ mnyam med skad gnyis smra ba chen po la/ de nyid kyi bzhed pa ltar rang la rgyun tsam gang yod kyi ngos nas rdzogs chen zab khrid kyi rigs mi 'dra ba bcu bdun tsam dang*/ gzhan yang rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon pa'i gter chos yongs rdzogs dang*/ rgyud bcu bdun/ snying thig ya bzhi/ rdor sems snying thig dang snying po snying thig bar do thos grol/ bla ma gsang 'dus/ rat+na'i thugs sgrub/ tshe sgrub gsang 'dus/ chos dbang gi thugs rje chen po/ myang gi lok+ti/ rin chen gling pa'i tshe sgrub 'od zer 103)'phreng ba dang rdzogs chen skor/ dri med kun dga'i mkha' 'gro yang tig dang mkha' 'gro bde chen/ las 'grel rtsal gyi phyag rdor/ zhang khrom gyi yang zlog dung mtsho ras pa'i trag shad/ klong chen pa'i bstan bcos thor bu/ myang gi pad+ma bka' thang sogs dang*/ gzhan yang gter kha du ma zhig gi chos bka'i rgyun rang gis gang thob dgongs bzhed dang mthun par phul/ chos kyi rje gsung sprul dam par mkha' 'gro snying thig gi dbang dang*/ thugs rje chen po yang snying 'dus pa'i dbang lung*/ drang srong lok+t-i'i dbang lung thugs sgrub gsang 'dus kyi dbang sogs phul/ rgyal sras rig 'dzin snying po la/ rdzogs chen dgongs pa zang thal/ thub pa'i skyes rabs brgya rtsa/ gter gsar gyi skor/ mnyam med sog bzlog pas mdzad pa'i o rgyan rnam thar chen mo/ tshe khrid rdor 'phreng sogs 104)dang gzhan yang mang zhig phul/ mkhas grub pad+ma blo gros pa la tshe dbang dang*/ 'khrungs rabs brgya rtsa sogs phul/ rig 'dzin mchog grub pa'i sku skye ba phyi ma la/ yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi dbang lung dang*/ pad gling tshe sgrub kyi dbang lung phul/

dkor zas skyel mkhan je mang song*// bza' btung longs spyod 'phel yang dge sbyor 'gribs// dkor lhongs dngos nyams rmi lam je cher gsal// res 'ga' lus la na zug bzod glags med// spyi bo'i gtsug nas rkang mthil yan chad la// mi na'i sa ni khab rtse gang tsam med// res 'ga' sems la don med zug rngu ldang*// dge sbyor lam 'khyer 'bad kyang nus mi thon// rmi lam kun la 'jigs rung chu bo dang*// g.yang sa chen por mi thar bzhin du 'gro// rang mi thar bzhin gzhan gyis 'brang zhing 'bod// 'di 'dra'i tshul mthong rang 126)gzhan dkor zan gyi// bla ma btsun gzugs gshin gson re ltos la// ya nga bag tsha spu tsam med pa tsho// kyi hud bar do'i 'phrang la ci ltar byed// bdag ni 'di 'dra'i tshul la bsam nas ni// bcad rgya'i rnam grangs je mang byas pa las// gzhan dag zog dang chos brgyad yin par mthong*// rgyu 'bras las la bslu ba med pa dang*// ye shes spyan ldan rnams kyis mkhyen gzigs 'gyur// shing mo bya lor rje btsun lo chen dang*// lha btsun chos rje kun bzang rnam rgyal gnyis// bka' gros mdzad nas rgyud 'bum rin po che// mtha' 'khob kong yul snga 'gyur bstan btsas su// spyan 'dren bgyi bar dus dbang lam stabs sogs// dka' bas gzhan gyi bgrod par mi nus gzigs// lha btsun grwa pa rnal 'byor pa bcu gnyis// brtul zhugs tshul gyis glegs bam re re khyer// nyer

127)'tshe med par gtsang rong gong ra nas// rgod tshang phug tu bco brgyad zhag gis 'byor// bkur bsti bgyis shing sku drin gso byed kyi// zhu yig phul ba yar la'ang bde bar 'byor/ sngon dus rang nyid grwa tshang 'gan khur tshe// gtsang khang sbug tu ston pa gtso 'khor dang*// rtse la gañdzi ra dang tshogs dung la// dngul shog dang bcas bsgrub 'dod nan tan du// 'bad rtsol byas rung las 'dzin su yis skabs sngon dus bu chu ru// 'bod mi dgos par dus babs slebs mkhan gyi// lha bzo mched gnyis de yang byon byung bas// thog mar rgod tshang nyid kyi nang 128)rten du// pad+ma gu ru'i sku bzhengs gser mthun pa'i// chos 'bul sdig zas min pa'i bkur bstis mchod// 'di bzung byang chub bar gyi gleng mchid kun// kho thag chod par zhus te 129)yar la bzhud// me khyi lo la mchod khang rten rnams bzhengs// gang zhig rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten// bzhengs zhes sems can mang po srog bcad pa'i// sha khrag longs spyod yo lang la brten pa'i// dge rtsa de 'dra sdig las sdig chen nyid// ci phyir zhe na dkon mchog la brten pa'i// sdig ni sdig pa gzhan las lhag par lci// yul dang rten gyi nus pa yin phyir ro// des na srog gcod dag dang ma 'dres par// lha bzo ba la de yi rgyu mtshan phul// gsol skrum la sogs skal bar dar ras dang*// ja snam ras sogs skam zog gya nom phul// zla ba drug tu skyo tsha tshod ma la// brten nas phyag las brtson pa mtha' 'khyol mdzad// bla brang nang dang grwa mang spyi pa la// rten bzhengs ched du rang la gang 'byor gyi// las yon gser zho lnga brgya'i rtsis su phul// lha bzo gsum la

130)gser dang dngul srang chen// lnga bcus thog drangs gos dar spus gtsang sogs// rta bzang dang bcas dgu mtshan bdun phul bas// lha bzo yon gyis mnyes rab phul tu gyur// dus gsum sangs rgyas mchog zung nye sras brgyad// sgo srung khro bo gnyis dang rgyab yol la// bla brgyud mdor bsdus dang bcas lha tshogs rnams// gnas chen mtha' dag sa sna chu shing rdo// rin chen dar zab sman dang sbyar ba'i rgyu// skyes chen du mas byin rlabs mdzad pa'i phabs// bkra shis dge legs 'byung ba'i rdzas tshang ba'i// sku sgyu las bzhengs gser zho brgya dang dgu// btul ba zangs chu dang bcas na bzar gsol// gdung gtso byas nang rten khyad 'phags rigs// de dus rang gi lag tu gang yod kun// thams cad sku rten rnams la nang bzhugs phul// ring srel rnam pa gsum gyi legs bkang bas// mthong thos dran reg 'brel tshad don ldan byas// yul dus gnas skabs rang dbang ma 'dus pas// spros bcas rab gnas 'ar 'ur ma grub rung*// rgod tshang nyid nas ye shes 'bebs bstim gyi// ting 'dzin rab gnas lan brgyar nan tan gyis// bzhi pa'i dus der lha babs dus bzang 'grigs// de nub me tog dngos su babs pa dang*// srung ma dpal mgon bdun cus byed skad kyi// rmi lam 'khrul snang de yang de nub byung*// gos kha lnga bcu las sgrubs gnam rgyan dang*// mchod pa'i yo byad gang 'byor rtsal phrugs phul// de skabs rang gi lag tu 132)ci yod kyi// dngos po bla chas phor sder thebs 'khrol tshun// thams cad lhag ma ma lus de phyogs btang*// shi gson dad zas 'brel pa thogs tshad dang*// kha lag zas chos 'brel thogs ltos bcas tshogs// ma rgan mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ris med kun// byang chub chen po'i rgyu ru bsngo smon 'bad// rang la 'khos khyer 'di las med na yang*// dge ba gang byed sdig dang ma 'dres par// byang chub sems dang bsngo ba'i rgyas thebs par// byas dang byed 'gyur kha zhe mtshungs pa la// gzhan dag mgu bar ci nus rang mnong med// me pho khyi lo rgyal zla'i dus bzang la// gter ston rig 'dzin chen po 'ja' tshon snying*// zhing 'di'i gdul bya rdzogs nye'i tshul ston khar// bdag la shog gsungs pho nya gnang 133)bar rigs// brtan bzhugs zhu shog phul dang smon lam rten// mar la bskyel mkhan lam du phrad 'dzom gyur// sku gdung rin chen zhugs la zhen phyir du// bdag la cis kyang shog ces nan byung kyang*// 134)sdom bka' 'bum sogs// bzhed mthun chos phul zla gsum bzhugs nas thegs// sngon dus gong rar rje btsun lo chen gyis// grwa tshang 'di la sprel zla tshes bcu yi// thebs rgyun gnang skabs mkha' 'gros 'phros khor du// sha cang sdig zas ma 'dres tshes bcu yi// mchod pa'i rgyun 'di khyed kyi 'dzugs thub tshe// bdag gis dngos po rim pas bsab rtsis dang*// gsol 'debs le'u bdun gdangs dbyangs rgyun khungs ma// yi ge la stod srid gsum rnam rgyal na// yod pas de yang zhus nas 'bul lugs byed// grwa tshang de la chang gi dri tsam yang*// nam yang mi 'byung thabs de khyed kyis rems// de skad gsungs gdams bdag gi yid la gcags// ji tsam 'bad kyang chang khrims 'grub dka' mod// rje de thugs zab brtan brling phul gyur tshe// la stod phyogs su bla ma drag sgrub pa// dka' spyad khyad 135)gsad gdangs rgyun zhu bar btang*// drung du 'khor tshe kong por ched du mngags// chang khrims ma 'khyol bdag kyang lung stong 'grims// gdangs kyi dgos med gyur kyang rje de nyid// dgongs pa bskang phyir bug sgor /sa mo glang lor dbon po dpon slob 'ga'// gdan 'dren yin pas cis kyang khams phyogs su// dpon slob ma nyung ba zhig 136)phebs dgos zhes// nan chags chen po mdzad kyang da ni bdag /gzhan don spros pa'i 'khor rgyun chod tshar bas// de 'dra'i re ba bdag la ma mdzad zhus// yang ni stong log slar yang bskyar chags kyi// bang chen yi ge mtshan pa tha dad bcas// byung la 'dus byas sgyu ma'i lus 'di yis// phyogs der nam yang tshe 'dir 'grod min zhes// kho thag chod pa'i yig 'phrin so sor bsrings// zang zing 'dod na phyogs der 'gro mod kyi// bdag la de min chos kyi snod ldan dkon// bstan pa'i mthar thug skye 'gro chags sdang rags// rang la thos bsam sgom stobs nus pa dman// gang nas bsam kyang 'gro phan mi 'grub la// zang zing brnyed kyang dgra 'dre dkor rnams smin// sdug bsngal du ma'i snod dang nyes pa'i gzhi// grwa 'khor thams cad phung la sbyor 'gyur bar// go bzhin 137)mig ldan g.yang la ci phyir mchong*// snyigs dus 'gro don mdzad par ming btags pa'i// rnam 'dren che chung 'bring kun chos kyi nor// bsgrub pa'i srol 'di mdo rgyud gang nas bshad// gzhan rgyud 'dul bar byed la rang smin dgos// rang nyid zang zing sred pa ma chad bzhin// gzhan la chos bshad thang mar brdal na yang*// ye shes spyan dang spyod ldan khrel ba'i rgyu// chos dang zang zing brje ba'i 'gro don de// rang gzhan gnyis phung sgrub pa'i las yin par// dkon brtsegs mdo dang nges don 'dus rgyud sogs// rgyal ba'i bka' lung kun la legs par gzigs// bskal bzang rgyal ba stong dang de yi 'khor// nyan thos mtha' dag nyin re'i bsod snyoms kyi// 'tsho ba las gzhan 'bul sdud ga la mdzad// gsang sngags rgyud las dbang bzhi'i yon gyi phyir// rta dang glang 138)po rin chen nor gyi dbyig

/bu dang chung ma rang gi lus srog bcas// 'bul bar gsung yang slob ma'i tshogs rdzogs slad// mos pas 'bul las bla mas ga la bzhes// de phyir chos dang zang zing brje ba yi// rnam 'dren zol ma'i rigs ni tshe 'di nas// skye ba kun tu byed par ma gyur cig /de ltar sa byi glang stag yos lo tshor// dmar ser bstan pa'i chag sgo 'khrugs long dang*// hor sog dmag dpung dkag rigs la sogs kyis// kong yul smad kun rba klong bzhin 'khrugs pas// khyim pa kun kyang nags su 'bros shing yib// zas nor thams cad chom rkun hab thob byed// bar do'i yul 'dra de yi gzhi bdag 'khrugs// 'byung ba ma snyoms sa chad brag ri nyil// shwa 'od chu log rlung 'tshubs shing chen 'gyel// snod bcud mi bde skye 'gro nyams thag cing*// lam 'phrang 'gag kun 139)mi ro gram ltar khrol// de 'dra'i rkyen gyis rang re dpon slob kyang*// 'tsho ba bsgrub dka' sgyu 'grul lam mi thar// gang ltar byas kyang zol mi bde ba yis// rang re'i zla grogs rnams kyang 'ga' zhig 'das// la la ma chags dgon par log nas song*// rang gi gcung dang nye gnas rgan po dang*// bdag cag gsum po legs nyes skyid sdug kun// bla ma dkon mchog gsum por blo gtad mthus// 'gal rkyen nyer 'tshe med par bde bar 'tsho// dge sbyor thun bar dag tu mtshan brgyad la// rdzogs chen snying thig bla rgyud kyis bskor ba'i// zhal thang dgu tshar gong sham bzang sgrigs bcas// gzhan lag ma 'dres rang nyid kho na yis// snying rus 'bad rtsol chen pos bzhengs shing bzos// rgyud 'bum rin chen glegs bam thams cad la// pa ti dmar po gos chen mu 'gril dang*// mu tig bsgregs pa'i ka tho 140)dang bcas pa'i// shubs dang na bza' sku rags gos chen las// bsgrubs pa'ang rang gis lag bdar 'bad pas bzos// slar yang gnas bcu'i sku thang bdun tshar bzhengs// kun kyang ri mo tshon byug gong sham sogs// ma lus rang nyid gcig pus snying rus 'bad// mkhas pa mgu ba'i rnam dpyod ga la shes// rang gzhan 'brel thogs tshogs rdzogs sgrib sbyong dang*// mkha' mnyam 'gro la phan phyir kho nar smon// ji ltar sngon tshe jo bo a tis shas// sāts+tsha la sogs nyid kyi phyag bdar mdzad// 'di 'dra'i 'o brgyal bdag cag bgyis zhus tshe// 'o na bdag gi lto yang khyed za'am// dge ba thams chad lag len 'ba' shig khyad// rang gi dge ba rang gis 'bad dgos gsungs// bdag kyang de lta'i rjes su 'brang khul bgyi// chu 'brug lo la rje btsun lo chen gyi// bka' tham skyel bar dz+nyā na kīrti gnang*// deng sang kong yul dus khams

141)mi bde zhing*// khyad par de skor bkag rigs kyis 'dzin tshe// dmag dang 'thab 'khrugs zol mi bde skad thos// de bas dbus gtsang phyogs 'dir byon pa na// sbyar nas dgongs pa gtad ltar zab lung dang*// rdzogs chen chos rje nam mkha' 'brug sgra gshegs// yos lor mtshungs med rig 'dzin snying po gshegs// sbrul la lha btsun kun bzang rnam rgyal dang*// shing rta'i lo la rje btsun lo chen yang*// mtsho rnams thams cad du// byin rlabs dam rdzas rin chen dar sman 'bru// smon lam bden tshig shog dril dang bcas pa// rat+na'i za ma tog bkangs mtsho mchod phul// sangs rgyas bstan dar sems can bde zhing skyid// bstan 'dzin thugs mthun chos spyod brtson zhing 'phel// rgyal khams nad mug 'khrugs brtsod zhi ba sogs// 'dod gsol lhag bsam rnam dag ngang nas bgyis// rgya la'i gnas mthil khris pa zhes 144)sprel lo la yul pa rnams bgros nas// rdo yi lha khang chung ngu zhig bzhengs par// rab gnas 'dun gtad dgos zer sprel lo yi// sprel zla tshes bcu'i snga dro byin 'bebs byas// de tshe rgod tshang pa'i rigs// rdul tsam med par rang gi go mod kyang*// skyabs mchog rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi// thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul 'di ni yid ches gnas// rang nyid sdon nas chang la mi spyod kyang*// grogs 'khor la sogs gzhan la phan phyir dag*// bstan pa'i rkang dang rgyun la phan re bas// me pho bya lo sa ga zla ba'i nya// thub dbang mngon par byang chub dus chen nas// bzung ste mi tshe'i lhag ma gang yod ring*// gzhis byes lam dang sa phyogs gar 'dug kyang*// myos 'gyur phabs kyis btab pa'i rigs gyur rnams// nye 'khor dri tsam mi bsten dam yang bcas// cho ga'i skabs kyi sman raka nam dgos kyang*/ 146)/rtsa brgyad stong sbyar rak+ta sum cu lnga// rgyud nas ji ltar gsungs bzhin sbyar ba'i rdzas// chu gtsang la btab ka ra bu ram sbyar// thugs dam skong byed dam tshig rdzas su bgyis// chang 'thung btsun pa'i rigs dang mi 'grogs shing*// de 'dra 'khor du mi bsten bcad rgya byas// gzhan yang 'o skol rnams kyi ston pa des// bstan la rab tu byung ba phyin chad nas// ma dag dngos po brgyad po ma spangs par/

rab byung dge sbyong rung bar ma gsungs na// ding sang mkhan slob dge sbyong rnams kyi tshul// 'di ltas rung bar bdag ni gtan mi sems// sa snying 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo dang ni// dkon brtsegs sogs las snyigs dus rab byung gis// ston pa'i bstan pa bsnub par gang gsungs pa'i// tshul nyid ji bzhin thog tu bab pa 'dir// ma bzod gzhan dag ci nyan rang kho na// spong ba'i zhe bcad ma bca' 'ga' bgyis pa'i/ 147)/thog mar nyer gsum lo la gzhon pa spangs// so gsum lo nas grong yul them pa spangs// so bdun lo nas dkon mchog sku blud dang*// dbang bskur chos bshad yon gyi zang zing spangs// so dgu'i lo nas rkang bzhi'i 'bul ba dang*// zhing dang go khrab mtshon cha'i rigs mi len// zhe gcig lo nas gshin dkor mtha' dag spangs// lnga bcur myos 'gyur rigs kun dri tsam spangs// nga gsum lo nas sku gsung thugs rten las// bzhengs pa'i dad 'bul mtha' dag ci 'dzems byas// gal te cis kyang len dgos byung na yang*// mchod rdzas mar me gtor tshogs mang bskol sogs// dad zas chus zos mi 'gro'i thabs la 'bad// de ltar byas kyang da dung dkor zas dang*// khyad par gshin po'i dkor rigs phran tshegs tsam// 'ong rgyu'i tshe na dngos nyams rmi lam la// bzod par dka' zhing 'jigs su rung ba yi// mtshan 148)ltar mthong zhing nyams su myong ba 'di// bdag nyid kho nar 'byung ba ci yi phyir// ding sang bla gzugs dge sbyong phal mo che// dkor zas 'dzem pa lta zhog log 'tsho lnga// 'bad pas bsgrubs nas nyams nga med spyod pa// de la dkor lhongs rnam smin gang du song*// bdag 'dra slan chad tshe rabs gang du yang*// log 'tsho dkor zas za mkhan mi skyer smon// sngon tshe dgra bcom mang pos dad zas ni// mi 'byung ched du bslab pa phul bar grags// ding sang dad zas 'tshol phyir tshul 'chos kyi// spyod pa mi bya'i sna med 'di 'dra ba'i// dkor zan de dag phyi ma cir 'gyur bsoms// rang la skyabs 'gro tsam gyi go rtogs dang*// yig drug 'phreng skor tsam gyi nus pa yang*// med bzhin gzhan gyi yar 'dren rim gro sogs// mi byed dgu byed mkhan tsho legs par bsoms// thog med pha mar gyur pa'i sems can dag

/bsad pa'i sha khrag 149)zas la brod gsar re// phor kha mtho dman tsam la'ang 'khang zhing brtsod/ 'di 'dra yon mchod gang la phan nam bsoms// snyigs dus bla ma'i tshul dang dge sbyong gzugs// khwa'am spyang ltogs bzhin du zas gos ched// dam pa'i chos btsongs zang zing nor bsgrub pa'i/ skye ba nam yang len par ma gyur cig /lcags mo glang lo dbo zla'i gnam gang nub/ /kong lha dkar po dri lha'i gangs nyil te// gtsang chab zhag drug bar du 'phred bkag gyur// gyen du 'khyil ba'i kong yul smad kun khengs// zhing dang tshal mnan chu 'gram yul grong 'jig /thams cad ci bya rtol med bdag rtsar rgyugs// 'byung bar rang dbang thob pa'i grub thob ni// bdag min phan thogs dka' mod skye 'gro'i don// gal cher thug pas ci phan los byed smras/ mchod 150)pa rgyas bshams gsol ba drag tu btabs// snang srid lha 'dre yul lha gzhi bdag la// bden tshig bka' bsgo'i yi ge dam rdzas dang*// me tog la sngags thum bur bcas pa rnams// gcung po la bskur khyod kyis myur song la// chu 'gram de ru bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom// gsol ba thob la phung po tshogs 'khor dang*// smon lam gdab cing thum 'di chu dkyil 'phangs// dung 'di lan gsum bus la shog ces smras// khos phyin de bzhin byas ma thag nyid du// gtsang chab khol te 'og tu 'or khungs rdol// gang la'ang gnod med gtsang chab rang mal song*// yul khams ma lus bde la 'khod par gyur// sang phod dpyid ka yang ni sngar las kyang*// nyis 'gyur tsam gyi gangs can khyad par snang*// 'di byung na ni dri dang kus dkar gyi// yul gru thams cad non par 'dug pas na// ci drag mkhyen zer 151)ring par rgyugs nas byung*// de tshe dam can rdo rje legs pa nyid// gnad la bkar ba'i bden tshig ras la bris// dam rdzas bdug rdzas me tog 'thor rgyu bcas// bskur nas ras de dar cog tho dang sbrags// nyen du che sa'i gdong der btsugs pa dang*// dam can gsol kha bsangs bsur dam rdzas bdugs// me tog 'thor sogs tshul khrims ldan pas gyis// ces smras de ltar byas pas gangs chad rgyu// de nyid rang mal du thim nyen dang bral// 'di dag bdag 'dra'i nus byin ma yin te// rang byung chen po pad+ma rgyal po la// gsol ba rtse gcig btab pa'i bden mthu lags// lo de'i mjug tu rgyal khams thams cad la// nad rims sna kha mi 'dra du mas khyab// skye 'gro mang shi sman pas mi phan pa'i// nyams thag sdug bsngal 'gyur mthong sems ma bzod// sangs rgyas ring srel gtso byas byin rlabs rdzas// rtsa brgyad stong

152)sbyar bdud rtsi a mṛ ta'i// sgrub pa byas mthar sman gyi sbyin sreg bgyis// 'byung ba rnams la sman gyi las sbyor dang*// 'gro ba'i nad rnams zhi bar smon lam btabs// de 'phral nad rims zhi ba'i nges shes rnyed// dad dang dag snang med la ci cha yod// 'gro la phan des rang nyid bsam pa rdzogs// lcags glang chu stag yos sogs lo de skor// rgyal khams mi bde'i mtshan ma mang ba dang*// nyang lung hor sogs dpung gis gang ba sogs// sems can rnams la sdug bsngal mtsho rdol mthong*// bdag 'dras phan thogs nus pa ma mchis kyang*// bsam pa dge ba tsam zhig lhur blangs nas// chu pho stag lo zla ba drug pa yis// yar tshes gcig nas tha skar nyer gnyis bar// zla gsum zhag ni nyi shu rtsa gcig ring*// gnas chen brgya la dpal ri gangs kyi 'dabs// byang chub yang rtse mthong zhing gnyan pa'i gnas// gang der 153)bdag cag mched gnyis gsang thabs su// phyin nas dbyar zla gsum der gnyan sa bcad// sa de kong yul mthil gyi sa gnad dang*// rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'i snying por lung bstan phyir// rgyal khams spyi dang kong yul skye 'gro la// phan du re ba'i rin chen bum pa'i nang*// byin rlabs rten dang bkra shis rdzas kyis bskangs// bstan 'gror phan pa'i smon lam bden chig bcas// bcug nas sprel zla'i tshes bcur rab tu gnas// sa dbyibs rgyal mtshan 'dra ba'i rtse mo ru// rlan gyi mi 'jig bgyis nas bum gter sbas// ka shi'i ras dang dar zab las bzos pa'i// 'phan dar che ba zhig la ston pa des// grong khyer 'jug mdor gsungs pa'i bde legs kyi// shis brjod chen mo yongs rdzogs bris nas btsugs// tsan+dan a ka ru sogs spos sna dang*/ shing sna bsur dud byin rlabs a mṛ ta'i// bsangs dud 154)bar snang khengs btang me tog 'thor// 'jig rten skyong ba'i lha klu gzhi bdag dang*// gnas bdag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad la// dkon mchog bden pa'i tshig gis bka' bsgo byas// skyabs gnas rgyal ba sras bcas lha bla ma// kun la snyigs dus sems can sdug bsngal can// mtha' dag thugs rje'i skyobs par gsol 'debs ni// gdungs shugs mchi ma 'khrugs pas nan cher bgyis// de tshe nyi char 'dres pa'i me tog char// 'ja' 'od lnga ldan rgya gram tshul du zug

/lho nub phyogs nas nam mkha' g.ya' dag dbus// 'ja' dkar pad sdong lo 'dab rgyas pa'i dbyibs// je nyer tshur byung mgo thog thad slebs tshe// rtsa ba gcig la rtse mo lngar gyes nas// nam mkha'i phyogs bzhir zug te yal nas song*// gnas 'di gzhan las 'phags pa'i ngo mtshar can// tshe 'di blo yis thongs pa ma gtogs pa// skyid chos zol bde bdag gi yul ma yin// skyo shas 155)nges 'byung 'phel zhing rig pa dwangs// nyin mtshan gnyis kar yengs 'khrul shas chung ba// dge sbyor bogs skyed thon pa'i gnas shig gda'// de nas lha babs dus chen nyer gnyis nyin// sus kyang ma rig slar yang rgod phug log /stag yos gnyis la dge sbyor 'phel ba las// chu lug zla ba drug pa'i bco lnga nas// sngon las dkor gyi rnam par smin pa dang*// 'phral rkyen dam sri'i bar chad mtshams sbyor mthus// bdag lus blo bur nad rkyen drag pos phog /gnyan tshad rlung gsum 'khrugs pas stod la gzir// kha med gnyan gyi nad zug smad la babs// rtsa dkar 'grams pa'i zug ngus yan lag gdungs// zas ni nyag ma gcig kyang khar mi tshud// nyin mtshan sbrel te spyi gtsug rkang mthil bar// zug gzer med yul khab rtse gang yang med// mig 'grib 156)rna ba 'on cing kha so sbir// rtsa chu kun sdams yan lag 'gul mi nus/ sems la 'khrul pa med tsam ma gtogs pa// lus ni dud khrod ro dang mtshungs par gyur// 'chi bar thag bcad blo kha nang du bzlog /zla ba phyed bar zas skom dri tsam med// sman gyi spros bcad shi ba'i grabs sdog byas// zla phyed 'das kyang tshe dus ma byas pas// yi dwags lta bu'i nyam thag ngang tshul la// gcung dang nye gnas rgan po sems ma bzod// lkog tu sman pa bos nas rgyu mtshan bshad// bdag la'ang sman zhig cis kyang zo zhig ces// nan skyed byas ngor sman thun 'ga' bsten pas// cung zhig zug chog zas skom nyung shas 'gro// rim pas bde skyed byung yang nad kyi rgyu// dkor gyi rnam smin nyid yin dkor zas las// gzhan pa'i 'tsho ba nam yang ma mchis tshe// da lta'ang dkor lhongs nam byung nad kyis mnar// dkor gyi rnam smin

157)da lta 'di 'dra na// shi ba'i dus rnam smin dngos gzhi 'byung*// de phyir bdag dang bdag 'dra'i dkor zan tsho// ya re nga yang bsam mkhan shin tu dkon// rang la dkor lhongs zug rngu byung dus su// mkha' mnyam sems can kun gyi las sgrib dang*// sdug bsngal ma lus bdag la smin nas kyang*// 'gro kun sdig sgrib sdug bsngal bral gyur cig /snyam pa'i sems bskyed smon lam snying nas bgyis// dad rdzas dar kha'am ja 'debs mar leb tsam// byung yang phud kyi dkon mchog mchod pa dang*// bla ma dge 'dun mchod dang sbyin pa sogs// dad zas chud zos med par dge phyogs gtong*// mi zad byang chub rgyu ru bsngo zhus bgyis// rang gi 'khos la dpag pa'i ci nus kyis// rgyal sras byang sems spyod la slob pa lags// de ltar rang lus nad gcong thar med kyis// rtag tu mnar 158)bzhin nye gnas rgan po yang*// sngon nas nad gzhi sna mang yod bzhin du// gnas der klo rong sa chu ma phrod dang*// na so'i khur gyis non sogs mtha' dag 'dzom// yos 'brug sbrul lor rim gyis nad babs ljid// sman dpyad zas sogs phrod bsten ci byas kyang*// phan med me rta sa ga'i nyer dgu la// bdun cu'i lo thog tshe 'di'i snang ba nub// blo thag chod dang dge sbyor yid la gsal// mtshams sbyor bzang po'i ngang la 'das pa la// ngo sprod gsal 'debs sreg chog bdun tshigs sogs// mtha' dag nged rang mched gnyis kho nas bsgrubs// phung po bsregs shul me tog dkar po skyes// nam mkha'i g.ya' dag rmi lam dge ba sogs// chos pa'i rkang mi drang ba'i mtshan ma mthong*// de lta'i nye gnas gsol dpon rgan po dang*// mi lo sum cu so dgur 'bral med 'grogs// pha ma 159)las kyang lhag pa'i drin can de// 'dus byas rang mtshang de ltar mngon sum gyur// de nas rang lo'ang drug cur slebs nye zhing*// phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel mtshams sbyor 'gyur// na rgas 'dzom pa'i rgyu lus phung po 'di// rgod tshang phug tu 'jog par ma shar zhing*// gnas der mi lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i bar// rnam g.yeng le lor ma sdad ci nus kyi// 'dus byas 'dus ma byas pa'i dge la 'bad// grogs dang grwa 'khor rnams la'ang dge sbyor bskul// mtha' khob yul gyi skye bo sdig pa can// kun kyang sdig spong dge ba'i bag chags bskyed// sgrub phug nang du rten gsum mchod rdzas dang*// dkor gnyer bcas bzhag dad ldan mjal 'dod rnams// tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong yul du rung bar byas// smon lam bkra shis rab gnas rten 'brel dang*// yul mi skya ser kun la rang rang gi

160)/skal bar gang 'tshams chos mthun bslab bya bgyis// me rta dbyug zla nyer lnga rgyal phur gyi// 'grub sbyor nyin par yar la kha bltas 'ongs// lam bar kun tu mthong thos kha lag zas// chos kyi 'brel pa thogs tshad ma lus pa// mngon mtho nges legs 'grub par smon lam btab// dad 'bul zang z-ing spu tsam mi len cing*// bdag cag bsnyen bkur ched du sems can gyi// srog gcod byed dogs tshogs 'khor sha chang gi /yo byad til tsam bdag gir ma bgyis shing*// yul ljongs kun la bkra shis me tog 'thor// skye 'gro rnams la rten gyis byin rlabs dang*// smon lam rnam dag mtshams sbyar yang dag bgyis// grub mtha' ris med dge 'dun ma lus par// rang rang dgongs bzhed dang mthun chos 'brel phul// rim pas smin grol skyed rdzogs gling du 'byor// dge 'dun rnams la rgyud 'bum rin po che// rang re'i 161)bka' 'bum bcas pa'i bka' gtad bgyis// gtsug lag khang la rab gnas me tog 'thor// zhag gsum bsdad nas chos dbyings 'od gsal rtser// gdan phabs slar yang deb mtshams la zhugs so// 'dus byas tshe 'di'i snang ba rmi lam las// ches cher rmi lam nyid 'gyur 'khrul pa'i gzugs// mi bden bden par 'dzin cing a 'thas kyis// bya byed zar zir byis rtsed lta bu 'dis// khams gsum 'gro ba col chung gtan du brid// mi rtag rtag tu re ba'i 'dod yon la// sred zhen lan tshwa'i chu ni 'thungs bzhin skom// da ni 'khrul zhen gtan chod 'gyur bar shog/ ces rang lo so lnga nas drug cu'i bar gyi tshul rnams rags rim tsam brjod pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o// ༈ dri bral pad sdong ge sar las// mtshan rdzogs rdo rje'i sku mchog ni// skye 'chi'i mtshan ma las 162)'das pa'i// mtsho skyes rdo rje des skyongs shig /rnam g.yeng 'khrul pa'i bya ba la// snying po med par go bzhin du// rnam par g.yeng ba'i 'khor lo ru// kun nas bskor ba'i ngang tshul brjod// ngo mtshar rnam thar brjod rgyu bdag la med// tha mal so skye'i kun spyod yig gzugs su// bkod kyang snag shog gron las gzhan pa yi// dgos pas dben kyang bskul ngo ma chog bri/

de ltar bdag 'dra snyigs dus kyi btsun rgan rang grol ba rgod phug dben pa'i nags khrod du mi lo nyer bzhi'i cad rgya grol nas yar la 'ongs te/ sngon gyi skyes chen grub thob mang pos zhabs kyis bcags shing chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i bsti gnas thang 'brog 'od gsal sgang gi sgrub sde nyid phyis su sog dmag byung skabs 'jig cing stongs te rmeg med du gyur pa de gso ba la bsam nas 'dun pa ched gnyer du gtad 163)pa las/ grwa tshang nyid nas bdag gi yul du dmigs pa'i spyil bu zhig btab 'dug par me rta dbyug zla'i yar tshes brgyad la gdan phabs te bcad rgya'i 'go tshugs/ de nas cho 'phrul gyi zla ba dang nye ba'i tshe/ rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs 'gro ba'i mgon po mnyam med sgam po pa chen po de nyid snyigs mtha'i 'gro ba rnams kyi skyabs mgon du byon pa'i rje btsun mchog gi sprul sku bzang po'i mtshan gyi grags dkar rtser khyab pa nyid shar phyogs kong yul gyi bstan 'gro spyi dang bye brag pa mtha' dag la sman pa dang brtse ba dang bsod nams mngon par spel ba'i slad du gshegs pa dang dus mtshungs par gyur pa/ sngon nas bdag rgan po la brtse chen thugs rje'i gzigs tshul gang dang gang mi mnyam pas bka'i glegs bu bdud rtsi'i char rgyun lam gsum bgrod pa'i klungs ltar stsal bzhin pa las/ skabs 'dir 164)bdag gi mos pa dang rje de'i thugs rje gnyis po spra ba rlan med dang me stag phrad pa'am/ nya'i zla ba dang chu shel gyi gong bu 'dzom pa lta bu'i rten 'brel gyi mtshams sbyor bde blag nyid du 'grig pa'i mthus/ rje de nyid sku 'khor nyung ngu dang bcas te bdag gi bsti gnas su zhabs pad bka' drin gyi 'khor lo nye bar bkod pa gnang*/ de la bdag cag spyir ri khrod par gyur pa dang*/ khyad par 'tsho ba ngan ngon la brten pa'i rgyus bkur bstir bya ba'i dngos po dang yo byad kyi 'phongs kyang phye dang ja'i 'tsho chas phra mo tsam gyis mchod pa la dgyes dgur rol zhing*/

nyin thog thag tu dam pa'i chos kyi bka' mchid zab rgyas mtha' yas la rmad du byung ba yid la sim pa gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don dang dgos pa dang ched du bya bar 'os pa dang rang dang gzhan la phan pa rlabs po che 'byung ba'i dga' ston dam pa la bsnyel 165)ba med pa rgyun mi chad pa gegs med pa nor pa dang 'khrul pa'i dri mas ma sbags pa'i dam chos bdud rtsi'i dga' ston la rol ba nyin zhag bcu phrag gi bar du bzhugs yul gnang zhing*/ bdag 'dra ba'i rmongs rgan la dag pa'i snang ba rmad du byung ba'i gzigs pa mtha' yas pas rab tu 'dud tshul dang*/ rin thang can gyi dngos po gya noms pas bsnyen cing*/ bkur ba'i mdzad pa bsam 'das kyi rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa mngon sum tu ston par mdzad kyi/ kho bo cag gi ni dam pa la dam par 'os pa'i ri mor bya ba dang bkur stir bya ba'i dngos po dang rtsol ba dang nus pa dman pas/ thal mo sbyar te mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ smon lam bzang pos mtshams sbyor ba tsam zhig zhabs tog gi snying por bgyis so// yang de dang rjes su mthun 166)par/ me lug gi dbyar gsum me tog gi lang 'tsho mngon par ston pa'i dus kyi tshe/ ri bo shān+ti'i gdan sa chen po nyid nas/ rgyal ba lo ras/ mkhas grub gtsang chen chos kyi dbang phyug sogs skyes chen tshar du dngar pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa rgyal sras dam pa chos nyid klong grol lam/ mtshan gzhan 'dzam gling dpal 'bar bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan de nyid kyang*/ lugs gnyis ka nas sku yul shin tu gnyan cing che ba'i rgyu mtshan khyad du gsad nas/ sprang rgan bdag 'drar thugs dag pa'i snang ba mi mnyam mnyam pa med pa'i gdung shugs kyis rlabs chen pos nye bar bskul nas/ dpon slob gsum 'ba' shig tu mdzad de dam pa'i chos kho na ched gnyer gyi dgongs pa rtse gcig pas byon pa la/ sngar smos pa bzhin longs spyod kyis mchod par bya ba'i dngos po ni bdag cag gis rngo mi thog pa

167)nyid las/ de skabs nam dus kyi 'byor pa sha mo dang lo tshod kyi rigs sna tshogs rgyas pa'i dus su gyur pas ji ltar rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje'i rnam thar dang rjes su mthun pa'i mchod pa stabs shing*/ bzhugs khang nor nyan med pa'i khar/ sa khad mtho zhing char zhod rab tu che bas 'o brgyal gyi rgyu kho na la yang ji mi snyam par mdzad nas dbyar zla gsum gyi ring la bzhugs te/ dam pa'i chos kyi gtso bor so thar byang sems sngags sdom gyi nor bu'i do shal tshar du dngar ba mgul pa'i rgyan du bzhes tshul gnang zhing*/ gzhan yang theg mchog rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan pa mtha' dag gi yang bcud dam pa la nan du sgro 'dogs gcod pa gnang ste/ mtshan thog thag tu mi gzims par nyams bzhes kyi brtson pa phul du phyin pa gnang nas dmigs rim re re 168)la yang dag ther thon pa mdzad/ nyin gyi ring la bdag gi rtsar bzhugs ring 'jig rten 'phros gtam lab lab sogs kyis skad cig kyang ma slad par/ res 'ga' bskyed rim/ res 'ga' nges don/ res 'ga' rig gnas/ res 'ga' phyag len/ res 'ga' gdangs dbyangs tshun gyis mtha' brten te/ mdor na bdag gis ma thos mi shes pa ni phar zhog thos shes su gang gyur pa phran bu ci yod mtha' dag la spom yor dang gal ma mchis su mi 'jog par phu thag gting nas chod par mdzad nas/ 'di bzung byang chub bar gyi mol mchid mtha' dag pa'i tshul yang lhag ma med par bzhed pa ni gting rdzogs su mdzad de gshegs so// yang de'i dgun gyi dus na/ tshe rabs mang po nas smon lam gyi 'brel pa rmad du byung ba can gyi skyes chen pa mi pham mgon po'am/ nges don mthar phyin dpal 169)bzang po de nyid kyang gong nas yig brgyud la brten pa'i chos kyi tshul sgo du ma nas dri ba dang lan gyi tshul rgyun ma chad pas rjes 'jug rnams la chos sbyin 'dod 'jo dam par 'gyur ba'i sgo 'byed dang bskul ba por gyur pa'i skyes chen de yang byon te/

sku gsung thugs rten gtso bor gyur pa'i phyag rdzas kyi snying po mtha' dag nged la spungs par mdzad bzhin du/ dad pa'i dbang po mngon par brtas pa'i thugs 'gyur ba med pa'i snod bzang por/ thog mtha' bar du dge ba'i dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i sdom gsum tshogs rdzogs dang*/ theg chen smon 'jug gi byang sdom sems gsum gcig tu dril ba dang*/ smin byed dbang la brten pa'i rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa gsum gyi bdud rtsis yongs su gtams par mdzad/ de dag gi dgongs don snying po rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la sngar nas nyams bzhes rtag par 170)mdzad bzhin pa nas/ slar yang theg pa kun gyi rtse rgyal du gyur pa'i phyag rdzogs zab mo'i gnad don grub thob rgyud pa'i zhal rgyun dri ma med pa la dogs gcod zhib nan phu thag chod par mdzad nas sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi zhal bzhes dang bcas pa gnang zhing*/ ji tsam bzhugs pa'i ring la yang tho rengs dang po nas sku bzhengs te bdag gi sgom khang la skor ba dang brgya phyag gsol 'debs yan lag bdun pa smon lam gyi mtha' rten dang bcas pas snying rus tshad med du gnang ba yang rjes 'jug dag la brda ston du mdzad nas thegs so/ de yang thang 'brog gi sgrub gnas su grwa tshang nas phral bzos kyi spyil bu de sa dmigs cung zad ma non par mthong bas/ da lta ma 'ongs pa'i rten 'brel la phan du re bas 'od gsal sgang gi rtse mo rgyal mtshan gyi tog lta bu'i sa de la/ gong du mchog sprul chen po byon pa'i skabs 171)su sa 'dul la dmigs pa'i thugs dam phyag nas sogs kyang zhus shing*/ lug lo'i dbyar kha grwa tshang gi dge 'dun bcu phrag tsam re re mos su byas nas khang las bgyid pa la sha dang chang gi longs spyod gtan nas spangs te/ gzims khang khyon mi chung tsam du bzos pa bkod pa yang rang nyid kyi shog bu la ri mo bris pa bstan nas bzo bcug pas gegs med du 'grub cing chos dbyings 'od gsal rtse mor ming btags/

zhal bsro bgyi ba dang lhan cig der spos nas mtshams mus la bzhugs so/ de nas sa sprel rang lo re gcig pa'i thog tu babs pa'i tshe/ spyir 'dus byas kyi chos la rtag mi thub pa dang*/ sgos su rang gi tshe tshad phal cher yang rdzogs pa dang*/ khyad par lus la nad gcong sna mang pos rtag tu mnar ba 'di nam zhig dkor lhongs drag po cig gis blo bur du bsdu bar nges pas na/ 172)long yod rig pa gsal dus 'dir chag med lus med du byas la/ shi nad phog tshe 'gyod med du bya'o snyam nas/ sa sprel zla'i tshes bcu nyin dgon gsum ga'i bla ma dang grwa pa rags bsdus 'dzom pa byas te/ rang gi lag tu sngar gyi lhag ma dang 'phral mar gsar byung gi rigs kyi rten mchod rol cha bla chas mchod rdzas dbang chas sogs gang yod dang*/ rgyud 'bum rin po ches thog drangs pa'i po sti gsum brgya tsam yod pa rnams dang*/ mdor na bstan pa'i zhabs tog gi cha rkyen du gyur pa che chung 'bring gsum thams cad bgos nas/ gtso che ba grwa tshang dang*/ gzhan gnyis por gang 'tshams pa phul nas 'chug med kyi yi ger btab ste so so la brtsis sprad/ sgam po nas bdag gi tshe'i rten 'brel la dgongs nas ched gtad du bzos te gnang ba'i gañdzi ra yang grwa tshang gi mchod khang rtse la gzungs bzhugs khyad 'phags dang bcas te bstan pa yun du gnas 173)pa'i rten 'brel gyi srog shing du phul/ 'od gsal rtse'i gzims khang nyid du'ang sku rten khyad 'phags kyi rigs bdun bcu rtsa lnga dang*/ de'i mchod cha sna tshang spus gtsang ba'i rigs cha tshang ba dang bcas pa bzhugs su gsol bar bgyis so/ gzhan yang sngar nas rje lo chen drung gi dgongs pa ji lta bar grwa tshang 'di la myos 'gyur chang rag gi dri tsam yang med pa gcig thub na/ dge 'dun rnams 'tsho ba'i sems khral gyis g.yeng ba byed mi dgos pa'i gsol phogs kyi thebs rgyun bskal pa'i bar du chags med 'dzug pa'i thugs rtsis dang*/

de dang mthun par nged rang gis kyang thabs dang rtsol ba gang zab bgyis nas spo khams 'jang zhabs sogs nas kyang mthun 'gyur byed mkhan mang du yong rtsis dang bcas pas legs tshogs che ba zhig 'ong bar yod na'ang*/ grwa pa rnams kyi chang khrims byed ma nyan pa'i rgyu rkyen gyi de ltar ma grub pa 'di ni 174)rje lo chen drung dang bdag gnyis ka'i bsam pa ma rdzogs pa 'di bstan pa'i sku bsod kyis ma theg par snang ngo*/ de ltar lug sprel bya gsum gyi lor chos dbyings 'od gsal rtse mor lo gsum gyi bcad rgya'i nges pa yang grub cing*/ bstan pa'i spyi btsas dang sgrub sde'i sa bon yang thebs par gyur mod kyang*/ gnas de'i chu dang rang gi lus khams nad gzhi mthun par ma byung ba dang*/ rang gi rgyun gyi 'tsho ba ni rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje'i rnam thar gyi rjes su 'brang dgos phyir sa khad mtho ba'i chu bsil rgod 'dis kyang sgyu lus la cung gzan par snang tshe re shig gtsang chu la brten na legs sam snyam pa dang*/ de bzhin byung na gnas chen mgo dgur skye ba gong ma'i mdzad pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i ngang la shi na 'gyod pa mi 'ong snyam ste/ sa bya tha skar gyi nyer lnga la 'od gsal rtse nas btegs shing*/ ma 'gyangs par shi na sems 175)kyi lhag ma mi lus pa bsam ste/ lam zhor du grwa tshang gi chos ra'i bzhugs khri nas dge 'dun rnams la 'di phyi bar gsum gyi bya spyod spang blang nyams len sogs 'phral yun mtha' dag pa'i bslab bya zhib thems su bgyis shing*/ sngar rgod tshang nas yar la 'ongs skabs dang mtshungs par lam bar yul grong thams cad la bkra shis bde legs kyi shis brjod dang*/ rmongs dad kyis 'dus pa'i khrom tshogs mtha' dag la yang ji ltar sngon 'o skol gyi ston pa nyid byang chub kyi spyad pa spyod tshe sems can gyi don du smon lam ji ltar mdzad pa dang rjes su mthun par/

bdag nyid mthong ba dang thos pa dang bza' btung sogs mthun rkyen sbyor zhing stobs pa dang*/ mos pas phyag dang skor ba byed pa ma zad/ log lta dang skur 'debs byed pa rnams kyang bdag gi byang chub kyi sems kyi nus pas myur du bla na med rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur gyur cig ces sogs kyi smon 176)lam kha zhe med par btabs/ lam ring kun tu yul dang skye 'gro sogs gang mthong yang*/ da ni bdag myur du 'chi bar nges tshe da phyin chad nas 'di dag mthong bar mi 'gyur snyam pa'i skyo shas dang ma bral bzhin du phyin pa nas/ na so rgud cing nad gcong gis nyams thag pa'i dbang gis lam ring bgrod pa'i nyams zungs dang bral bas gru'i gzhon pas drangs te zhag bdun du lam bar thams cad la yang dgon sde tha dad pa'i bla ma dang dge 'dun grub mtha' tha dad pa so so nas kyang kha na ma tho ba med pa'i nyer spyad ja dang dkar spro sogs gya nom pa dag stabs cing*/ rang rang gi yid 'dod dang mthun pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ la las bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ la las lhag pa'i lha tha dad kyi sgom bzlas/ la las dpe'i bklags lung*/ 'ga' zhig gis sgom gyi ngo sprod dogs gcod sogs so sos ji ltar don du gnyer ba de dang mthun pa'i chos 'brel gyis dgongs 177)pa bskangs/ 'ga' zhig ni gtsang po phan chun gyi 'gram ngogs nas phyag dang smon lam byed pa dag la yang 'brel pa bzang thogs kyi sems bskyed smon lam rnam dag gi sa bon btab te/ mdor na 'khos med bdag 'dra la blun dad kyis re ltos byed pa'i skye 'gro 'di dag gis da ni slan chad bdag mthong bar mi 'gyur la bdag gis kyang 'di dag mthong ba ma yin no zhes yid la sems shing skyo shas dang nges 'byung gi rlabs 'phreng kyang g.yo ba nyid dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas smin drug gi yar tshes dang por gnas mchog mgo dgu sgrub sder 'byor/ de nyin kyang kong stod zing 'o shod kyi dpon khag so so nas brtan bzhugs kyi tshogs mchod sogs bdag cag gzhis byes tshang mar gya noms dang bcas/

kun dga' ra bar sgrub grwa dge 'dun rnams la thog mar dal 'byor rnyed dka' nas 178)brtsams te mthar thug byang chub la reg pa tshul gyi nyams su blang bya'i rim pa thams cad legs par 'doms par bgyis shing*/ der tshogs kyi khrom pa dag la'ang me tog 'thor zhing bkra shis bde legs kyi smon lam bzang pos mtshams sbyar nas/ bla brang gzims chung du slebs ma thag tho gtsugs te bcad rgya'i mu la zhugs/ slar yang dben pa'i mtshams khang zhig ma zos na bla brang zo mi sod par bsam ste/ lcags khyi'i dpyid ka nas khang las kyi mgo tshugs kyang rang nyid ni bcad rgya las ma g.yos pa'i ngang nas/ gcung po dang bla ma rta mgrin rdo rje gnyis la bkod khyab kyi do dam dang*/ thang 'brog grwa tshang gi dge 'dun kha shas dang blang la byung ba dang*/ gzhan sgrub sde nyid kyi dge 'dun gang yod des che 'khyag chung 'khyag gi las kar 'bad cing yon bdag gi rigs kyis dang blangs dang bcas pas 'bungs te ma 'gyangs par 179)mtshams khang nyis thog legs par grub cing*/ tsher ma zug pa tsam gyi nyer 'tshe yang med pa'i legs tshogs gong 'phel du gyur/ smin drug gi yar tshes bzang por mtshams mus nas skya rengs shar ba dang mtshams khang de nyid du gzhan dang ma phrad par bzhugs te nang du yang dag par 'jog pa las g.yo ba med par gnas so// me phag gi lo la long yul bde chen dgon par mchod khang rnam pa sngon nas yod kyang rten bzhengs kyi rigs gang yang ma 'grub par yod pa la/ 'di skabs bla ma rig 'dzin ye shes pas lhag pa'i bsam pa dang sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus rmad du byung bas nye bar bskul zhing 'bad pa che thang du bgyis nas rten bzhengs kyi 'dun pa la gegs med kyi srung 'khor dang*/ gzungs rab gnas mgo 'don bdag rkyen sogs gang cir dgos tshul byung bar 180)rjes su yi rangs dbugs byung gzengs bstod du ci 'gyur dang*/

sku rgyu la nye bar mkho ba'i gnas chen mtha' dag gi sa rdo byin rlabs rten rdzas/ tshon dang gser la sogs pa ji ltar 'byor pa dang*/ bar chad bsrung ba'i ting 'dzin gsol 'debs smon lam sogs kyang rang gi 'khos dang sbyar te bgyis/ sgam po nas kyang rten gyi na bza' dang gser shog mtshon sogs kyi gnang cha dang*/ sprul sku ba rdzong rta sogs sku drin bskyang cha mtha' yas pa mdzad pa la rten nas mtshan brgyad lha khang sogs gegs med ngo mtshar gyi phung por grub pa la gzungs rab gnas kyang rang nyid kyis rten 'brel mtshams sbyor ci nus do gal du bgyis shing me tog kyang babs par gyur pas yul dus mtha' dag la dge mtshan gyis khyab par gyur to/ ༈ chu byi'i lor sngar nas dgongs pa phur tshugs su gtad cing bka' 181)gros kyi gsung shog rgyun ldan du phebs pa ltar/ rgyud 'bum rin po che'i lung rgyun gsan par sgam po nas rje btsun mchog gi sprul sku bzang po'i mtshan gyi grags dkar srid pa gsum na khyab pa nyid gdung brgyud zhabs drung rin po che mthu stobs dang bcas pa'i dpon slob rnams mgo dgu sgrub sder ched gtad du phebs par/ dngos 'byor zang zing gi bkur sti'i mchod pa ni/ bdag rang yang dad ldan 'ga' zhig gis byin pa'i phye rkyal tsam la brten pa las ma mchis tshe zhabs tog ga la 'byor kyang*/ chos kyi mchod pa ni dgongs pa dang sbyar ba'i ji ltar nus pa'i zhabs phyi sgrub khul gyis/ rgyud 'bum rin po che las rdzogs chen skor gyi glegs bam 'ga' zhig dang*/ gzhan rdzogs chen snying po gser gyi yang zhun gyi zab khrid snyan rgyud ma nan chags dang*/ rdor sems snying thig zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi 182)zab khrid sogs kyang dpyis phyin du gsan pa gnang zhing*/ chos bka' gzhan ma'i bklags lung sogs kyang bar mtshams tshar 'drongs gang che dang*/ bstan 'gro la dgongs te dam rdzas bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub pa zhig kyang ci nas byos shig gsungs nas/

de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring srel gyis gtsos pa'i byin rlabs rten rdzas khyad 'phags bsam 'das sman dang bcas pa stsal bar mdzad pa'i bka' spyi bor blangs te rang gi lag thog tu gang yod kyi sman dang dam rdzas khungs thub rnams kyang rtsal sprugs su bgyis pas/ bdud rtsi a mṛ ta spungs che bar bsgrubs nas sku tshe'i rten 'brel dang dam rdzas kyi phabs rgyun du phul zhing rang gis kyang zhus/ de ltar rgyud 'bum yongs rdzogs gsan pa dang*/ rdzogs pa chen po yang tig gi mun khrid gcig brgyud ma sogs gsan zhing nyams bzhes gnang ba sogs kyi phyir/ yun ring ba zhig bzhugs pa gnang bzhed dang*/ bdag 183)rgan po yang da ni yun ring 'tsho ba yang dka' la/ gal te ma shi na'ang mig dbang rim gyis 'grib tshul 'dis bklag lung sogs 'bul thub pa yang dka' bar gda' bas da res zhib nan mdzad na legs tshul zhus shing de ltar gnang rtsis la/ 'di skabs kong yul skor la dge lugs las gzhan pa sus kyang dad 'bul dkor sa sogs dang blang mi chog pa'i bka' khrims dam pa dang*/ rje de nyid la skya ser phal mo ches dad gus che ba'i gshis kyis/ khrims bdag rnams kyi dgongs pa 'khrol cha ma gnang ba'i rkyen la brten nas zla gsum tsam las lhag pa bzhugs pa skabs su ma babs par/ slar yang gdan sa chen por gshegs par mdzad/ lar rje nyid mchog gi sprul pa'i sku dngos yin pa tsam du ma zad par/ shes bya'i gnas mtha' dag 184)la mkhyen pa rab mchog phul du gyur pas 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i mnga' bdag dam par gyur na'ang*/ snyigs dus kyi dge sbyong phal mo che rnams log par lta ba la ches goms shing*/ khyad par gsang sngags snga 'gyur bar khas 'che ba'i rmongs rgan dag bdag tu lta ba'i mun pa dam pos bcings pa rnams chos la phyogs ris dang bdag bzung ba la zhen cing 'thas pa dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di dang 'di ni rang phyogs pas byas pa'o snyam pa'i zhe 'dod skong bar 'gyur phyir la dgongs nas/

'ja' tshon zab gter gyi chos ka'i nang tshan tha dad pa so so'i dbang bskur la nye bar mkho ba'i mtshams sbyor dmigs rim ngo sprod lo rgyus dag sbyor sogs med mi rung gi yig cha ltas chog gis rigs rnams dang*/ gzhan yang*/ gnas bcu'i cho ga byang sdom thugs bskyed chen mo/ bla ma mchod chog sogs nyer mkho ji snyed pa dag kyang khyod 185)kyis sgrig rtsom gyis shig ces pa'i bka' rjes su gnang bar mdzad pa la/ bdag 'dra ba'i so skye blun po thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs ma chod nyams myong gi rtsal dang ma ldan/ tha na gsung rab kyi brda dang tha snyad tsam la yang ma byang ba 'di 'dra bas ni bstan bcos rtsom pa po'i mtshan nyid rab 'bring mtha' ma gang gi phyogs tsam du yang mi nye na'ang*/ mchog gi sprul pa'i sku de lta bu dag ni ji ltar sangs rgyas rnams kyis 'khor 'das dus gsum mtha' dag gi rgyu rkyen 'bras bu mthar thug gi bar gyi gnas rnams thams cad lag mthil na kyu ru ra'i 'bras bu bzhag pa ltar sgrib med du gzigs shing mkhyen la/ mkhyen bzhin du don med don log gi gsung mi 'byor zhing don ldan don chen gyi dgos pa btang snyoms su 'jog par mi mdzad phyir/ 'di lta bu gyis shig 186)par bka' stsol ba 'di ni dgos pa dang ldan yang ngo snyam pa'i mos pa dag yid rab tu gzhungs pas ji ltar nus pa bzhin bris shing*/ gang bris pa de dag kyang rnyed bkur grags 'dod kyi bsam pa'am/ gzhan dag khyad du gsod 'dod sogs bsam pa phyin ci log gi dri ma skra rtse brgyar bshags pa'i cha shas tsam gyis kyang ma slad par/ gang zhig 'di dag gis ni skyes chen dam pa de dag gi bzhed pa ji lta bur skong ba dang*/ chos de dang de dag gis gdul bar bya ba'i yul du gyur pa ji rnyed pa thams cad dag dang smin dang rgyud grol zhing yang dag pa'i 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i don bde blag tu 'grub pa'i thabs dang cha rkyen du gyur cig gu snyam pa'i lhag bsam 'ba' zhig pas kun nas blangs te byas kyi gang zhig lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i byang chub kyi sems ni nor bu rin po che bsam 'phel

187)dbang gi rgyal po las kyang ches cher lhag pa'i yon tan gyi nus pa dang ldan par rgyal bas mdo sde rin po che thams cad du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ de lta bas na mchog gi sprul pa'i sku des bka'i bskul ba ji ltar gnang ba bzhin rtsom pa'i rigs mang du bgyis te spyan lam du bstar nas tshig dang don la bdag cag so skye'i ma rtogs log rtog gi dri ma ci mchis pa sel bar gsol ba btab kyang*/ de lta bu dgos pa ma mchis zhes rjes su gnang bas dbugs dbyung bar mdzad pa yang bdag gi nus pa ma yin te/ rje de nyid kyi thugs rje'i nus pa las byung ba'i dge mtshan du nges shes brnyed par gyur to/ ༈ yang re shig gi tshe/ bdag sngon smin grol skyed rdzogs gling gi tshogs dung chen mo gnyis gter byon khungs btsun byin rlabs can yin rung 'dab gshog med pas de la gser 188)dngul gang 'dzom gyi gshog pa zhig bsgron pa'i bsam pa rgyun ldan du yod na'ang*/ bzo nor nyan dang do dam pa nyams ldan sogs ma 'dzom pa la/ phyis su grwa tshang gi gnyer pa phrin las chos 'phel sogs kyis nye bar bskul te rje btsun mchog gi sprul sku de nyid la bdag gis gsol ba btab pa bzhin thugs rjes dgongs nas zhal gyis bzhes pa la/ bdag gi lag nas de'i cha rkyen du dmigs nas gser zho bco brgyad dang*/ dngul srang drug cu re gnyis/ dngul chu srang bzhi bcu zhe lnga dang*/ phra 'debs rgyu'i rin chen 'ga' dang gzhan yang de'i nyer mkho la ja gos dar sogs dgu tshan phul/ grwa tshang nas kyang rta pho dang drel gzhon gyis gtso byas te bcu gsum tshan sogs phul nas/ bal po'i gso skyong yon rdzongs sogs dgos cha thams cad dang tha na sol ba tshun gyi yo byad ma lus pa sku zhabs rin po che nyid nas khur bzhes 189)mdzad pa'i dngul ljang brdungs la gser gyi g.yogs shing phra tshom gyis spras pa lta bas chog mi shes pa grub nas phyi snod sgam cha khyad par can dang bcas pa bka' drin du bstsal bar mdzad do/

༈ de las gzhan yang mgo dgu sgrub sde kun bzang chos gling gi kun dga' ra ba'i tshogs dbur/ bzhugs khri stong par bzhag pa mi legs par bsam nas/ ji ltar sngon 'o skol gyi ston pa dga' ldan du yum la chos gsung pa dang sum cu rtsa gsum na dbyar gnas la gshegs nas dge 'dun rnams kyi gral dbu stong par gyur pa'i tshe tsan+dan gyi sku tshab rin po che bzhengs te bzhugs su gsol bas bkra shis byin chags su gyur pa'i dpe bzhin gnas chen mtha' dag gi sa rdo chu shing dang*/ rten sna tshang dang*/ dar sman rin chen 'bru snang dang 'jim pa sbyar ba las sna tshogs rang grol gyi 190)'dra sku bzhengs su gsol ba'i nang bzhugs su sangs rgyas kyi ring srel dang*/ byang chub kyi ljon shing gang gi spyi bor reg pa tsam gyis ngan song las skyob par sangs rgyas nyid kyi zhal gyis bzhes pa dang*/ gu ru rin po che'i na bza' dang*/ bai ro dang chos rgyal gyi na bza' sogs mdor na byin rlabs can gyi nang rten bsam 'das dang*/ rang grol nyid kyi tshems mche ba/ skra sbubs na bza' sogs dang*/ gzhan yang gzungs yong rdzogs tshar nyer lnga sogs bzhugs pa dang rab tu gnas pa yang rang nyid kho nas mtshams mal du nan chags su bgyis pas ye shes bzhugs pa'i rtags ldan du nges shes brnyed pa la na bza' bzhugs khang sogs kyang cha 'grigs su bsgrubs nas dad ldan rnams kyis phyag mchod kyi zhing dam pa dang*/ sgrub grwa'i 'dus pa rnams kyi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor byin chags su 'gyur ba dang*/ yul dus gnas 191)skabs ma lus pa'i sa gnad rten 'brel gyi dgos pa chen po la nye bar dmigs nas bgyis pa'o// ༈ de ltar gong du smos pa bzhin rang nyid kyi na so dang nad gzhi'i rgyu rkyen stobs che ba'i mthus 'di tsam la 'byung 'dus kyi khang rul gog po 'di zhig par gyur na skabs la yang babs shing 'gyod 'tsher yang ma mchis pa dang*/

'chi ba'i gnas kyang dud khrod chen po pad+ma brtsegs pa'i cha shas su gsungs pa'i gnyan khrod 'di kho nar gdos bcas kyi phung po 'di la dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs mchod du gyur na ci ma rung snyam pa'i 'dun pa rtse gcig tu che yang re shig thog tu ma babs/ rang phyogs su gtogs pa'i rmongs zhen pa rnams ni bdag 'dra 'chi dogs kyi sems khur byed mod kyang*/ nged las gzhan pa mang po dag mi rgan bdag 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid 192)bstan par gyur na dga' mgu yid rangs par 'gyur ba'i rigs can shin tu mang ba dang*/ gnas de yang sa 'dus che zhing lam po che'i dbus su gyur gshis kyis rab tu mi dben pa dang*/ rang nyid 'du long spangs te bsam gtan gyi khang bur yang dag 'jog las gzhan pa'i bya ba mi byed na'ang*/ thag ring 'grul pa tshun gyis bdag gi grags pa skam po la yid brtan du byas te rgyang ring nas dben khang mthong ba la yang phyag dang smon lam sogs byed pa de la yul gnyan po bdag thugs la ma ran par zug rngur gyur pa sogs mdor na rang la brten nas gzhan sdig gsog pa mthong bas yid khong du chud de slar yang de las ches cher dben pa'i lung stongs dag 'grims pa zhig 'dod kyang lang tsho rgud tshabs ha cang che shing yan lag kyang mi bde la mig kyang 'grib pa'i gnad kyis thag ring 193)bgrod pa'i nus stobs ni gting nas zad pas na/ slar yang chos dbyings 'od gsal rtse mor 'byung 'dus phung po 'dor ba las gzhan pa'i go skabs ma rnyed la/ der bsgrod pa la yang sngar ltar mi 'dus kyi zing long dag byung na khrims bdag rnams yid mi dgyes pa'i sgrib gsog tu 'gyur bar rig nas/ mgo dgur lo bzhi'i bcad rgya grub pa'i chu glang dbyug zla'i nya la phyi nang sus kyang ma tshor bar skya rengs shar ma thag tu gru bo che la zhugs nas chu bo pak+ṣu'i gzhung lam drang por brgyud nas rings rings par song ste/

nub mo yang nags tshang tshing stug po'i khrod du zhag mal bgyis shing*/ gru las thon pa'i tshe yang mtshan thog thag nyid du lam srang la bcom skyungs te 'bad pas 'ong shings ji ltar dmus long la dmigs bus bya ba bzhin du grogs kyi sna khrid dang 'then 194)'phul la brten nas bgrod de/ chos dbyings 'od gsal rtse mor slebs ma thag nas sngar bzhin rang shong gi mal du zhugs te/ 'di snang gi sgyu ma'i ltad mo la zhen pa'i thag pa ni bcad/ sngar byas kyi bag chags rmi lam las kyang rmi lam chen por gyur pa'i ngang tshul ji rnyed pa'i mtshang ni rig da lta ji ltar shar zhing mthong tshor ltar snang ba 'di thams cad byis pa'i rtsed mo la rgan pos lta ba bzhin du gyur/ 'jig rten phal pa'i skye bo lta ci smos te/ bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa'i chos pa spyi dang khyad par du rang re'i slob rigs grwa 'khor phal mo che rnams tshe 'di'i lto gos gtam gsum 'ba' shig don du gnyer ba las/ tshe phyi ma dang gtan gyi 'dun ma sgrub mkhan ni nyin skar las kyang ches dkon par yang mthong*/ rang gi nus pas de dag gi rgyud 'dul ba'i smin grol du byed pa ni lta zhog 195)tshe 'di'i snang shas cung zhig chung du gtong thub pa tsam yang mi nus tshe rang gi thugs rje byin rlabs ni de lta bur zad la/ gzhan gyi dag snang mos gus kyi gdung shugs kyang de dang mtshungs shing*/ deng sang 'khor slob kyis bla ma la dad gus che che mor 'dod pa thams cad ni yang dag gi dad pa ma yin no/ 'jig rten gyi dpon g.yog gi sdug zhen pho rus dang khyad ci yang med la/ de yin pa'i rtags su bla mas ci mdzad legs mthong gi blo rgyud la ma 'char bar/ rang la mnyes pa mdzad na bla ma bzang*/ rang la mi gnyes na ngan par 'dzin pa 'di kho nas slob ma'i mtshan nyid bde blag tu ston pa nyid du gsal tshe/ de bas na da ni rang lo bdun cu la nye ba'i mi tshe nub kyi ri mgo nas phyi mig lta ba'i dgong nyi lta bu 'di/

do nub 'chi'am/ sang nyin 'chi'am 196)snyam pa'i blo thog nas 'phur la khad kyi bya bzhin te/ ji ltar sngon bka' gdams kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen glang ri thang pa sogs tshogs chos gnang ba'i thun mtshams su 'o skol do nub ma shi na 'di'i 'phro sang nyin 'chad par bgyi'o/ zhes rgyun par gsung ba de lta bu las kyang kho bo na so ni rgud/ dbang po ni 'grib/ tshe chad ni rdzogs/ nad kyis ni gdungs/ lus nyams ni zad pa 'di lta bu ci'i phyir 'tsho/ nam 'chi ba'i tshe yang nyams len zab mo la gdeng thob pa gang yang ma mchis pa'i khar/ dad zas shin dkor khro chu khol ma dang 'dra ba 'di nus pa nan tar che ba'i mthus/ lam dang lam ma yin pa dang gnas dang gnas ma yin pa shes par dka' zhing dkor sgrib kyis 'thums pas rang rig pa'i ye shes la rang dbang thob pa ni dka' ste/ gal te rang rig ye shes la dbang bsgyur nus pa lta bu'i tshe na ni/ ngo bo chos kyi 197)sku spros pa dang bral ba'i rang sa zin cing*/ rang bzhin longs spyod rdzogs pa gsal dag thig le'i dkyil 'khor chos dbyings khyab pa nas/ thugs rje kun khyab sprul pa'i sku gdul bya'i khams dang mnyam pa'i ye shes kyi sgyu 'phrul zad mi shes pa'i phrin las rlabs po che phyogs dang ris su ma chad par 'khor ba'i mtha' mnyam du 'byung bar smon pa ma gtogs/ ding sang gi sku skye'am sprul skur btags pa'i dad zas kyi zong rin 'di lta bur mi skye ba dang*/ de yang thos bsam sgom dang smin grol gyi mkhyen rtogs 'dzom ma 'dzom sogs bla ma'i mtshan nyid la mi lta bar/ 'jig rten pa'i bag ma ltar/ sgo mtshar khyad/ mi chos mkhas mi mkhas/ 'jig rten pher yo sogs yod med la sku skye'am bla ma nyan mi nyan gyi mtshan nyid du byed pa'i yul dus gang zag 'di 'dra ba'i khrod du nam yang mi skye ba'i 198)smon lam snying khung rus pa'i dkyil nas 'debs pa ni bdag 'dra'i zhe dam yin pa dang*/
